texto_original: Hi. Totally missed your kickstarter for chronicles of drunagor age of darkness.   When can I buy the core game and the expansions ?  Thank you
respostas:
Dear Terry
Thank you for contacting us and for supporting Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness!
Unfortunately we are completely sold out at this moment! Every copy of Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness that was printed is already on their way to a loving backer as we speak. We were completely and happily surprised by how fast that happened!
That being said, you could probably check with the local retailers you have access to. Some retailers did get copies of CoD: AoD and its expansions and even a few extras. We do recommend doing it asap though. We've been receiving many emails like yours and we imagine that many people like you who couldn't get their hands on a copy of CoD: AoD and contacted us might be doing the same.
Although we don't have any further copies at this time, we've been receiving lots of requests like yours. Due to all of these requests, we're thinking about making a reprint. However, even if we manage to make a reprint, due to production costs in China and logistics costs, both on the rise, the values will not be the same. So it is probably best to get them now if you can.
Either way, if you want, we can add your email address to our waiting list. That way, we can contact you in case of a reprint or if after all orders are delivered there are any unclaimed or spare copies. For that, just please send us your best email address!
Thank you once again for your contact, interest and your support.
Best regards,
Yes please add me to waiting list.  I'm based in UK. Can you tell me which, if any, UK suppliers had stock of the game?  Thank you

Good afternoon Marcio – I hope you are doing fine.

 

I just wanted to follow up on last weeks call regarding the supplies of games made into Germany to make sure my understanding is correct.

 

During our call, Nigel Matthews from GamesQuest confirmed that the customs entry for your shipment of games into Germany had been submitted with ‘Intermail’ (a separate fulfilment company distributing the games in Germany) named as importer of record with their EORI number used to clear the goods through customs.  Import VAT was incurred based on the purchase value of the goods from the manufacturer in China, with Import VAT and customs duty incurred.  As Intermail are not entitled to recover the import VAT and the German authorities have therefore benefited from this payment , you have been advised by Nigel that there is no requirement to account for German Output VAT on the supplies to the individual consumers in Germany.  You are both in agreement that this position should not be disturbed and that you would like us to submit a ‘nil’ return for Creative Games Studios in Germany at this time.

 

I would be grateful if you could confirm that this is correct, following which my colleague Andrzej will be able to submit the VAT return for you.

 

Kind regards


David

is no other than the hero Levi Lee! Levi is that kind of hero about whom
many stories have been written. He is the proof that a valorous heart is
the most important thing and that no hero is small, no matter how huge is
the adventure at hand. If you don't know what we are talking about yet,

amazing video and for bringing us such joy. Thank you, Levi! Keep fighting

improve even more on our future projects. If you're not on our social media

aspects of the game and the most amazing community, you, help each other,
and debate on the world of Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness. Until
we meet again keep fighting the Darkness, Heroes! Sincerely, Team CGS.

respostas:
Hi Adam Krause,
Thank you for contacting us and for your interest in Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness!
​
Unfortunately we are completely sold out at this moment! Every copy of Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness that was printed is already on their way to a loving backer as we speak. We were completely and happily surprised by how fast that happened!
That being said, you could probably check with the local retailers you have access to. Some retailers did get copies of CoD: AoD and its expansions and even a few extras. We do recommend doing it asap though. We've been receiving many emails like yours and we imagine that many people like you who couldn't get their hands on a copy of CoD: AoD and contacted us might be doing the same.
Although we don't have any further copies of CoD: AoD at this time, we've been receiving lots of requests like yours. Due to all of these requests, we're thinking about making a reprint. However, even if we manage to make a reprint, due to production costs in China and logistics costs, both on the rise, the values will not be the same. So it is probably best to get them now if you can.
Either way, if you want, we can add your email address to our waiting list. That way, we can contact you in case of a reprint or if after all orders are delivered there are any unclaimed or spare copies. For that, just please send us your best email address!
Thank you once again for your contact, interest and your support.
Best regards,
Customer Service

---------------------------------------------------------------------
Due to high volume, please allow 2-3 business days for a response

respostas:
Hi Tony,
​Thank you for contacting us and for supporting Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness! It's great to hear that you received your game! Please consider rating us at
BGG
and leaving a feedback if you have the time after you played it. These simple actions are priceless to a small company like us and helps us keep creating the best games we can!
Unfortunately we are completely sold out at this moment! Every copy of Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness that was printed is already on their way to a loving backer as we speak. We were completely and happily surprised by how fast that happened!
That being said, you could probably check with the local retailers you have access to. Some retailers did get copies of CoD: AoD and its expansions and even a few extras. We do recommend doing it asap though. We've been receiving many emails like yours and we imagine that many people like you who couldn't get their hands on a copy of CoD: AoD and contacted us might be doing the same.
Although we don't have any further copies of CoD: AoD at this time, we've been receiving lots of requests like yours. Due to all of these requests, we're thinking about making a reprint. However, even if we manage to make a reprint, due to production costs in China and logistics costs, both on the rise, the values will not be the same. So it is probably best to get them now if you can.
​
The only extra we have any spares at this moment is
Handuriel
. If you would like, we can quote how much it would be for the extra plus shipping and handling. If your shipping address is also the same you used on CrowdOx, there is no need to send us that information either.

Hello  I am writing to you with such a small and maybe a big question. Namely, I am a reviewer on the Polish Diceland website, and since we have been developing strongly for several years, we thought to establish cooperation with more publishers. Of course, if You were interested, then we can determine how you work, what deadlines you have to write the text, etc. I will also send You our statistics. I hope that we can work together and spread in Poland our beautiful hobby, because like You may already know, this industry is growing here a lot. When I saw Chronicles of  Drunagor: Age of Darkness I madly fall in love with it. And thats why Im asking about chance to show world Ur beatifull Games! Hope You can answer and we can work toogether!  Lately I work a lot with Ks projects like Middara, Okko Chronicles, Everdell etc. You can also check our website dicelandblog.pl 
 
Greetings Katarina 
Diceland reviewer
respostas:
Greetings, Katarina!
Thank you for contacting us and for your interest in Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness!
We are honored that you believe our game would be a good addition to your work. At this moment, we are mapping every one of the potential partners that have contacted us. The reason is that we want to have enough time to assess your work accordingly, since you put so much time and effort into creating all your media.
Once we have mapped that content we will reach out to all these partners that have contacted us with further info.
Once again, thank you for honoring us with your proposal.
If you have any further inquiries, please don’t hesitate to contact us again.
Best regards,
Team CGS

Hi Dra9ons,
Thank you for contacting us and for your interest in Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness!
Unfortunately we are completely sold out at this moment! Every copy of Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness that was printed is already on their way to a loving backer as we speak. We were completely and happily surprised by how fast that happened!
That being said, you could probably check with the local retailers you have access to. Some retailers did get copies of CoD: AoD and its expansions and even a few extras. We do recommend doing it asap though. We've been receiving many emails like yours and we imagine that many people like you who couldn't get their hands on a copy of CoD: AoD and contacted us might be doing the same.
Although we don't have any further copies of CoD: AoD at this time, we've been receiving lots of requests like yours. Due to all of these requests, we're thinking about making a reprint. However, even if we manage to make a reprint, due to production costs in China and logistics costs, both on the rise, the values will not be the same. So it is probably best to get them now if you can.
Either way, if you want, we can add your email address to our waiting list. That way, we can contact you in case of a reprint or if after all orders are delivered there are any unclaimed or spare copies. For that, just please send us your best email address!

Hi Oren Douek,
​
Thank you for contacting us and for your interest in Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness!
​
Unfortunately we are completely sold out at this moment! Every copy of Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness that was printed is already on their way to a loving backer as we speak. We were completely and happily surprised by how fast that happened!
That being said, you could probably check with the local retailers you have access to. Some retailers did get copies of CoD: AoD and its expansions and even a few extras. However, even if we manage to make a reprint, due to production costs in China and logistics costs, both on the rise, the values will not be the same. So it is probably best to get them now if you can.
Either way, if you want, we can add your email address to our waiting list. That way, we can contact you in case of a reprint or if after all orders are delivered there are any unclaimed or spare copies. For that, just please send us your best email address!

respostas:
Hi Michael Wilson,
Thank you for contacting us and for your interest in Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness!
Unfortunately we are completely sold out at this moment! Every copy of Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness that was printed is already on their way to a loving backer as we speak. We were completely and happily surprised by how fast that happened!
That being said, you could probably check with the local retailers you have access to. Some retailers did get copies of CoD: AoD and its expansions and even a few extras. We do recommend doing it asap though. We've been receiving many emails like yours and we imagine that many people like you who couldn't get their hands on a copy of CoD: AoD and contacted us might be doing the same.
Although we don't have any further copies of CoD: AoD at this time, we've been receiving lots of requests like yours. Due to all of these requests, we're thinking about making a reprint. However, even if we manage to make a reprint, due to production costs in China and logistics costs, both on the rise, the values will not be the same. So it is probably best to get them now if you can.
Either way, if you want, we can add your email address to our waiting list. That way, we can contact you in case of a reprint or if after all orders are delivered there are any unclaimed or spare copies. For that, just please send us your best email address!
Thank you once again for your contact, interest and your support.
Best regards,
Customer Service

respostas:
Hi there,
I hope this email finds you well. ☺
So I went through the material you sent me and have found quite some issues with the translation. I'm attaching a few pages of reviewed content with some comments for you.
As you can see, there are a lot of issues of various levels: grammar, consistency, sentence structure, readability, capitalization and typos.
Please go through the comments I added to the document and do ask if anything seems unclear.
Now... I'm guessing this is an automated translation service that has innate issues when confronted with "complex" sentences, although the typos would indicate some sort of "human" interaction as a machine never writes a word wrong.
Be that as it may, the material is close to unreadable, with many sentences that make little or no sense and I can't imagine this would help any Italian player enjoy the game more... And unfortunately this holds true for the rulebook, the cards and the expansion material as well.
I really want to help you out with this, but this requires way more than a "proofreading" step.
Proofreading such material should be done (ideally) without ever having to check the source text and should focus on correcting minor issues.
What would be required to make this text readable would be a close-to-full retranslation...
Now, I would never ask you our full fee for such a task. I appreciate your efforts as a small company to bring out such a great game, with lots of text and narrative in different languages but please do let me know if you have a budget, even a small one, available for this task as I would love to loop in my team on this project. This would allow us to really make AoD an enjoyable experience for Italian backers too as I am enjoying it very much myself and it would be a shame to let a bad translation ruin the flavour and the narrative that you have clearly invested so much in.
I'm sure we can find some sort of agreement to work together and really do you game justice! 👍
Thank you,
Flo

Hi Florian D'Anna,
Thank you so much for that feedback! We understand it and it really help us to communicate with our volunteer translators.
These heroes have reached out to us in order to help the community by translating this content. In addition, we will make the .idd files available for the community once they are finished so that they can make any alterations if they feel like it.
​
Once again, thank you so much for dedicating this much attention and time to Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness.
​
Best regards,

Thank you for contacting us and for your interest in Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness!
We have been receiving lots of requests like yours. Due to all of these requests, we are thinking about making a reprint. We are still not sure if there is going to be a reprint or not. So it is probably best to get them now if you can from your local retailers if they have pledged.
Either way, if you want, we can add your email address to our waiting list. That way, we can contact you in case of a reprint or if after all orders are delivered there are any unclaimed or spare copies. For that, just please send us your best email address!

texto_original: Hello! I only recently found out about your game, Chronicles of Drunagor, through a different kickstarter's comments section. I'm disappointed I missed your KS campaign, especially with how many KS Exclusives there were. Is there any chance there will be extra copies available to buy or a second wave or anything like that to not miss out?
respostas:
Thank you for contacting us and for your interest in Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness!
Unfortunately we are completely sold out at this moment! Every copy of Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness that was printed is already on their way to a loving backer as we speak. We were completely and happily surprised by how fast that happened!
That being said, you could probably check with the local retailers you have access to. Some retailers did get copies of CoD: AoD and its expansions and even a few extras. We do recommend doing it asap though. We've been receiving many emails like yours and we imagine that many people like you who couldn't get their hands on a copy of CoD: AoD and contacted us might be doing the same.
Although we don't have any further copies of CoD: AoD at this time, we've been receiving lots of requests like yours. Due to all of these requests, we're thinking about making a reprint. However, even if we manage to make a reprint, due to production costs in China and logistics costs, both on the rise, the values will not be the same. So it is probably best to get them now if you can.
Either way, if you want, we can add your email address to our waiting list. That way, we can contact you in case of a reprint or if after all orders are delivered there are any unclaimed or spare copies. For that, just please send us your best email address!
Thank you once again for your contact, interest and your support.
Best regards,
Team CGS

Thanks for the reply! Sad I missed out but glad to hear you guys had such a success. If you would add me that'd be great, burford_tim@hotmail.com
I don't mind paying a little more I just hate missing out on the exclusive stuff, you know? Anyway, thanks again!

Hi Timothy!
Thank you! We just signed you up for our waiting list. In case we have any spare copies in the future or a reprint, we will reach out to you!
Best regards,
Team CGS

respostas:
Hi Nate Leavitt,
Thank you for contacting us and for your interest in Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness!
Unfortunately we are completely sold out at this moment! Every copy of Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness that was printed is already on their way to a loving backer as we speak. We were completely and happily surprised by how fast that happened!
That being said, you could probably check with the local retailers you have access to. Some retailers did get copies of CoD: AoD and its expansions and even a few extras. We do recommend doing it asap though. We've been receiving many emails like yours and we imagine that many people like you who couldn't get their hands on a copy of CoD: AoD and contacted us might be doing the same.
Although we don't have any further copies of CoD: AoD at this time, we've been receiving lots of requests like yours. Due to all of these requests, we're thinking about making a reprint. However, even if we manage to make a reprint, due to production costs in China and logistics costs, both on the rise, the values will not be the same. So it is probably best to get them now if you can.
Either way, if you want, we can add your email address to our waiting list. That way, we can contact you in case of a reprint or if after all orders are delivered there are any unclaimed or spare copies. For that, just please send us your best email address!
Thank you once again for your contact, interest and your support.
Best regards,
Customer Service

respostas:
Dear Nikita Cherkasov, thank you for your email.
My name is Márcio and I am one of the founders and the business executive of Creative Games Studios, pleased to e-meet you.
As you know we are the publishers of the board game Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness that was launched on Kickstarter back in 2019. Our game has received great feedback since it had arrived on the market last month. We are completely sold out since last year and with so many demands that we have decided to launch a reprint and a massive expansion of our game Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness next July.
That's great to know that you would be interested in
localizing
Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness. Our game is huge and we know that would be hard to have it all
localized
, but surely we have to have the Core Game and the main expansions, which are The Raise of Undead Dragon, Desert of Hellscar, and The
Apocalypse
. Other ones are also available if you believe they could be worth
localizing
with MOQ of 1.000 copies. The only thing we can not have in retail is the Stretch Goals that are exclusive for crowdfunding.
It is great to hear from you at this moment since based on our strategy, we are planning on having
localization
for some content of the game, and right now, we are (have done a few) finalizing agreements with potential partners worldwide, before the campaign starts. We have specific terms for distribution and also for localization that we are open to discuss with you.
Please check, in first hand the draft page (
link HERE
) of our next campaign... but please, keep it for your eyes only since it is a work in progress and not informed to the market yet.
So if this something that interests you and Gaga Games, please let me know.
Wish you all the best,
--
This message is intended only for the use of the individual or entity to which it is addressed and may contain information that is privileged and confidential. If the reader of this message is not the intended recipient, you are hereby notified that any dissemination, distribution, or copying of this communication is strictly prohibited. Please notify the sender immediately by e-mail if you have received this e-mail by mistake and delete this e-mail from your system.

Nice to e-meet you,
Márcio.
Thank you for a thorough description of our possibilities and for a draft page, which looks extremely interesting.
I am convinced that if we will successfully cooperate on that project, we would surely localise all possible (and acceptable for both sides) content your game may offer.
As publishers we have different ways of cooperation with our collegues on different projects. When it comes to a small game we prefer to get a licence and fully manufacture the game in Russia, but since your game is a large project we would consider co-production.
I would be glad to discuss with you specific terms you mentioned.
But before I could be more definite we would have to test your game. What possibilities do we have? If it is present on TTS or you could send us a sample it would be great.
Look forward to your answer

Nikita Cherkasov
Game Selection Manager

[https://ipmcdn.avast.com/images/icons/icon-envelope-tick-round-orange-animated-no-repeat-v1.gif]<https://www.avast.com/sig-email?utm_medium=email&utm_source=link&utm_campaign=sig-email&utm_content=webmail>  Livre de vírus. www.avast.com<https://www.avast.com/sig-email?utm_medium=email&utm_source=link&utm_campaign=sig-email&utm_content=webmail>.
respostas:
Hi Cesar,
About "Event", on the SETUP section you should find the explanation on how and when to use.
​
"+30 HP" is for the player to use when there is the need to represent that a specific monster has that many HP extra. In that case you just put the token on the Monsters HP Board.
​
"Fury", "Wild Cube" and "Fruit of Life" are ​class related so you can find their uses when looking at the characters boards. "Time" tokens are used when prompted for example, to mark a turn or more that a monster cannot act.

Hi Creative Games Studio Team,

I was wondering if you were keen on supporting something my fiancee and I
are working on. We used to hold gatherings for free at my place for people
to meet new people over board games pre-COVID here in Singapore as we
believe that board games are a really good way to build social bonds,
especially in a country like Singapore where it was harder to meet new
friends (a couple of friends here I knew grew pretty lonely because of the
culture here). We also do this to share our love for board games with the
people around us as well as to give females a safe space to game. As things
open up here in Singapore, we are starting off with smaller sessions and we
thought that we could also use this platform to introduce new games to our
friends/participants!

As such, while this is new to me, I was wondering if I could ask for your
support with any demo/review copies so that we can feature your games at
our events and on our instagram (instagram.com/boardgames.joel). I do
understand that we are pretty small and it may not be worth the money for
y'all so we understand if you aren't keen. But just thought that there's no
harm in asking and either way, we appreciate you reading this email as we
really love the look of your games and I understand that you would get such
requests frequently :)

Joel
respostas:
Greetings, Joel!
Thank you for contacting us and for your interest in Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness!
We are honored that you believe our game would be a good addition to your work. At this moment, we are mapping every one of the potential partners that have contacted us. The reason is that we want to have enough time to assess your work accordingly, since you put so much time and effort into creating all your media.
Once we have mapped that content we will reach out to all these partners that have contacted us with further info.
Once again, thank you for honoring us with your proposal.
If you have any further inquiries, please do not hesitate to contact us again.
Best regards,
Team CGS

Hi Ali, Marcio here!
I´ve jumped in because this is very concerning to us...
We have seen many distinct problems with the delivery of packages with some damages in the boxes, which we understand might occur and that's the reason why we have some of the spare parts available to the backers within our logistic hubs worldwide.
But it sounds odd when one of these hubs cannot open an SKU and send an exact replacement (box, tiles, dices, etc) and has to send a whole new SKU box with all of the content in it just because of damage by logistics in the outside box lid.
Please correct me if I am understanding it wrong, but we can not replace a damaged card box with a full new SKU, what we do expect is that we replace the exact item, if it is a box lid, just send them the box lid and we keep the remaining items in the storage to be used for another replacement that will be necessary for the future.
Also, we can not have the chance for the backer to incur extra importation fees for a replacement if we sold this item to them free of any import taxes.
Besides that, for every transportation problem we have like this one, we do except to fill a complaint with the logistic partner (FedEx, DHL, etc) in order to have the issue reimbursed by their insurance, ok?
Let me know if you have this clear and if we need to raise this problem to ShipQuest or to Intermail because I could do so if you tell me that is necessary.
Thanks a lot for the great work

You Gamefound order and your EZ Pay Subscription are set with different rewards.     Your Gamefound order is set with the EZ PAY - GAMEPLAY ALL IN [$99.99 + 5x $62.00 = $410] reward;  While your EZ Pay Subscription is set with the EZ PAY - Entry Pledge [$99.99 + 2x $55.01 = $210] reward;     Having that in mind, we would like to know which reward you would like to keep.      1 - In case you want to keep the lower value pledge, (EZ PAY - Entry Pledge [$99.99 + 2x $55.01 = $210]) we can make the changes needed and your order should be good to go.     2- In case you want to keep the higher value pledge, (EZ PAY - GAMEPLAY ALL IN [$99.99 + 5x $62.00 = $410]) we can launch the payments you have done through your subscription to your Gamefound order so that you will be only needing to pay the difference, which we will arrange to be done, for your convenience, through Gamefound.     Please let us know how you would like us to proceed and we will get to it as soon as possible.     If you have any further inquiries or anything else we can assist you with, please do not hesitate to contact us again. respostas:
Oi Francisco,
​
Obrigado por entrar em contato conosco e por apoiar Chronicles of Drunagor.
​
Verificamos a sua pledge e vimos que a sua última parcela do EZ Pay, no valor de $94, que deveria ter sido cobrada em 2 de Janeiro, não foi devido ao cartão ter sido negado.
​
Diante disso, nossa equipe lançou o produto EZ Pay completo para todos os backers EZ Pay, assim como os valores faltantes das parcelas para que pudessem sem pagos diretamente através da plataforma da Gamefound para maior conveniência. Esse valor é o único que vemos faltante no seu pedido. Quanto ao pagamento de $66,99, este foi corretamente efetuado no dia 08/01/2022.
​
Quantos aos itens que gostaria de remover, nós podemos fazer isso do nosso lado. Para isso, basta nos informar quais itens gostaria de remover.
​
Quanto ao reembolso para pedidos EZ Pay, é retornado 70% da entrada ($99.99) feita pela Gamefound e mais 90% das parcelas pagas pela CGS Store. Quanto aos pagamentos realizados diretamente pela Gamefound, que não sejam referentes ao EZ Pay, será reembolsado 80% dos valores se o pedido for feito após 15 dias do pagamento. Caso o pedido seja feito antes de 15 dias do pagamento, o reembolso será de 100%. O reembolso pode levar de 5 a 10 dias úteis para ser efetuado e deverá ser pedido antes de a produção do Apocalypse Adventures se iniciar. A data de início da produção ainda será divulgada.
Caso tenha quaisquer outras dúvidas ou algo com o qual possamos auxiliá-lo, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato conosco novamente.
Att.,
Augusto

an 80% refund it is! I joined voluntarily and am now opting out of
my own volition, so I am fine with CGS at least retaining the third
party fees.
As for why I opt. out, it's a mix of events.... Shipping is very
expensive and VAT cuts too deep into my budget, and as a board gamer
who likes to control his own destiny, there's the uncertainty of
whether a game based on 1 x D20 would really appeal to me and my
gaming group. Certainly there are ways to mitigate this, but it also
makes me uncomfortable to spend such a high amount of money on a
game that may not end up on the table very often. I know now that
the game is undergoing some changes, but most reviews don't show
that progress. Maybe some glimpses of a more advanced scenario could
have eased my fears, but I don't think CGS did anything wrong.
That's my take on crowdfunding. So I'm not sure that smoother
payment processing and an early announcement of the final shipping
price would have changed my mind on this issue, as I think giving
backers more time to choose will affect the eventual outcome of the
reviews. I mean, the more people buy and regret it later, the more
biased the reviews are after the fact.
So all in all, I'm happy with how CGS handled it, knowing that
trying to do something new has its ups and downs.

A few of our EZ Pay backers have reached out to us claiming that an additional value is being charged after they completed their installments. When checking these pledges, what we saw is that other rewards were added while the EZ Pay down payment for their reward was removed.
If you are an EZ Pay backer, we ask you to please refrain from deleting two items from your order:
EZ PAY - *reward name* [$99.99 + *number and value of installments* = *total value]
and
EZ PAY - *reward name* - COMPLETED
. These two items are essential for the EZ Pay rewards to be counted as paid.
If you need to choose the language of your game, please do so editing the
EZ PAY - *reward name* [$99.99 + *number and value of installments* = *total value]
sub-items.
The
EZ PAY - *reward name* - COMPLETED
is added by our team, together with all the payments made through our CGS Store platform via the EZ Pay subscriptions.
----------------------------

Any taxes that are charged are always charged in percentages and not fixed cost. Be it platform taxes, finance taxes and even production costs are always charged in percentage of transaction. That is why we always had our refund terms on our campaign page since day one, because we wanted our backers to make the best decision for them knowing the facts.
We cannot talk about other companies and their policies, only about us. Hi,
Im aware of the terms of policy regarding refunds. But thank you for the reminder.
I am sure of the refund and wish to confirm and proceed with it.
The reason I've decided to refund my pledge are because of multiple factors.
First off, because of personal situations i have to be more selective with my expenses for luxury items.
Secondly, the shipping price, not the fault of you guys of course but it's a bummer... Especially because my pledge isn't really that much. (base apocalypse pledge + hero pack)
I thought of editing my pledge, removing the hero pack, but that made almost no difference for the costs. With the VAT costs i would still need to pay up 40 dollars extra. Coming to a total price of 170$ for a 95$ priced game...
Again VAT is not your fault either but some kickstarters dont separately charge them. Its already calculated in the price, the way i prefer.
Now i can look past all of that if the game is worth it. But i dont feel its worth it...
I already thought the game was expensive during the campaign but i went with it cause the first campaign had Nice minis with unique sculpts. So i thought why not (+ i love that fallen sister in this campaign )
But i underestimated the costs to come, and it just isn't worth the value.
To be honest the amount of minis for even the base price (excluding shipping and vat) is low. Variety of sculpts is ok but limited (+ i have gotten a big collection of minis and have become more critical, looking for more unique ones) there were also no

For the first game, i originally canceled my pledge on ks and later repledged with late pledge for the "gameplay all in" cause it looked so good and i regretted not taking it. But i dont have that with this campaign. Sorry...
Of course this is just my opinion, and i mainly decide whats expensive or a good deal by comparing to other kickstarters and calculating the price per mini. So thats how i do that.
The golden days of Crowdfunding boardgames do seem to be over, as those great deals, one once found, seem to be more scarce.
Sorry for the rant but those are my reasons for requesting a refund. I rather get 80% back of my expenses (taking a small loss) then spend a butload of money on a small reward.
I do wish all the best to the company, and i will still be following your future campaigns.

texto_original: Dear Stephen Bishop,   We are contacting you today regarding your order for Chronicles of Drunagor.  As we are moving to the next step in our logistics process, it has been identified that your EZ Pay pledge shows some inconsistency.  For that reason, the system has changed the status of your pledge until this inconsistency has been solved.  In your case, our team checked that your Gamefound pledge and your EZ Pay Subscription aren't matching. One of the necessary items for the EZ Pay reward to work has been removed. What this causes is an error in both separating your items and also calculating the shipping rate.  We have addressed this kind of situation in our update #44, which you can check here: https://gamefound.com/projects/wearecgs/cod_apocalypse/updates/44     Our team has already re-added the missing item in order for your pledge to be correct again.   In your Gamefound order, a full-price REPRINT: Hero Pledge and NEW CONTENT: Apocalypse Adventures was added together with the previous  EZ PAY - Entry Pledge [$99.99 + 2x $55.01 = $210] already contained in it. Hi Steeve,
Thank you for getting back to us and for your patience as we have been seeing a high volume of requests. We are sorry that you feel let down. We did our best to bring information to all our backers whenever possible.
The information you requested regarding the shipping of different language items can be found on our update #47:
The reason is that different language items are being produced after the English items and the delay merely represents the time for the production to be finished at the factory.
Regarding the shipping rates, we had a great and elucidating conversation with Nigel Matthews, CEO at Gamesquest regarding that subject and the current global situation that is affecting every project concerning shipping rates. If you would like, you may access it through our update #52 here.
Unfortunately, at this time it is not possible for us to issue a refund for your pledge as we are already moving to our next steps with production, and delivery;  costs and taxes have also already been paid. Although we managed to extend the period in which we were accepting refunds for 4 months (until March 31st as informed on update #54), even though production was already going on, we are not able to remain open to refund requests at this time.
We hope this information will assist you and we would love for you to have a wonderful time playing Chronicles of Drunagor in your native language. We have put major efforts to that goal.

Dear CGS staff:

My name is Diego. I'm a freelance translator specialized in board games and
tabletop RPG. I came across your soon to be crowdfunding campaign of Dante:
The Invasion of Hell. I think it is going to be a big success.

Regarding that, you might be thinking about having it translated into
Spanish. If so, you might be still looking for a translator. And I might be
that translator (I know, a lot of 'mights' there, but who knows ;))

I have more than 10 year of experience translating games, having translated
both big and small projects (Etherfields for Awaken Realms or T.I.M.E
stories for Asmodee, for example). I'm  used to the tight deadlines used
when crowdfunding, so that wouldn't be a problem. I have attached my CV so
you can see other games I have translated.

I could provide a translation sample, if needed.

Should you be interested, please do not hesitate to contact me either by
mail (at this address) or directly at +34 696 119 125 (you can use WhatsApp
or Telegram if you like).

Best of luck with the campaign. Looking forward to hearing from you.

Regards,

Diego.

working time.*

I have been reviewing games in magazines and online for around 42 years, the last 12 on www.gamesgazette.co.uk and more recently boardgamegeek.com (600+ reviews on BGG).
I would like to invite you to look at the website, it's a no-nonsense site, plain and simple,  and read some of the reviews; there are current and recent reviews pages for board and console games plus the archive pages cover the last 12-15 months of mostly board games.
All games reviewed have been given to me for review by the publisher or an agent; a brief read through will show you that my reviews cover major commercial companies and independent companies alike. I do not get paid, nor do I want to be paid, for writing reviews. I write fairly and honestly giving my opinion but always keeping in mind the work and cost that has gone into producing each game.
I can write to a deadline if necessary, so for instance prior to a game being published or launched on a fundraiser, or I can receive a funded game and review it for late pledgers and shop buyers.
Please read some of the reviews before making your mind up.
Thank you for your time and consideration
Best regards
chris

Hello,

Please allow me to introduce myself. I'm Wouter from Belgium, and almost 
6 years ago I started an Instagram-page called Tabletopping, which first 
served as a photo logbook for my board game sessions. My audience 
quickly began to grow, which is why the last couple of years, I also 
decided to post reviews. Currently I have just over 24.000 followers, 
which still totally amazes me! We also see more engagement then ever, 
and have now over 400.000 impressions each month. I'm always trying to 
give my followers a brief gameplay overview but also my thoughts on the 
game, of course accompanied with a series of pictures I took.

Recently we also launched our website, allowing us to make more 
extensive reviews, as we often find ourselves limited by the maximum 
allowed post size on Instagram: https://tabletopping.games/ 
<https://tabletopping.games/> - I also crosspost these reviews on 
Boardgamegeek.com.

recently caught my attention. I was wondering if you would be able to 
provide me with a copy to review? I would be thrilled if I could show 
and tell my audience about the game!

I kindly invite you to take a look at my page to see if I would be a fit 
for you: https://www.instagram.com/tabletopping/ 
<https://www.instagram.com/tabletopping/>

Dear Creative Games Studio Team,

My name is Ilja Lieder and I am the new Junior-Category-Manager for the Board Game section here at ADC Blackfire Entertainment.
Board Games are a big and also passionate part of my private life, and I am more than joyful to integrate them in my everyday work from now on.
We at ADC Blackfire want to increase our products portfolio and especially the products from your boardgame series  Chronicles Of Drunagor (German and multilingual) have caught our attention.

texto_original:
Hello,

Sorry to reach out unannounced. My name is Jason Moore and I am writing to ask if you would consider sending me a copy of Chronicles of Drunagor, in light of the upcoming return to crowdfunding, for the purpose of an online review.

I write and curate a list of board game reviews on BoardGameGeek, under the heading “A Deck of Fifty-One.” I have been active on the site for the better part of a decade, and I am a long-time member of the One Player Guild, which this past year became the single largest community on the entire website (now standing at well over 15,000 members). I am particularly interested in shining a spotlight on the solitaire modes in board games – be they in games specifically designed for solo-play, co-operative games, or competitive games with a variant for solitaire play included by the designer – against an AI or set win condition, for example. Furthermore, at the request of several publishers I work with regularly, I have also recently expanded to covering a select range of competitive titles - which I promote as keenly as my solo-compatible reviews.

At time of writing, I have seventy-three reviews posted – which seem to have proved popular with the community. If you wish to look at samples of my previous work, this link will take you to an up-to-date database of them: https://boardgamegeek.com/geeklist/263694/deck-fifty-one-repairmanjacks-solo-play-review-pro. My recent reviews for Tawantinsuyu, Dark Souls, Maeshowe, Arcadia Tenebra and 1066, Tears to Many Mothers should illustrate the breadth of my gaming interests and how I approach writing about them. One of my pieces was publicised as a “review of the week” by the site, in 2019, which raised the profile of my project somewhat. I also constantly publish session reports and photos on the guild's monthly "Solitaire Games on Your Table" geeklists. Thousands of us hang-out in those each day, discussing what we are playing. I would, of course, be documenting my plays here as well as in the review itself. (I was actually the host of this list, for the first time, throughout July of last year.)

On 1st May, this year, I was inducted into the One Player Guild’s Hall of Fame, in recognition of my review work, and for my contributions to the hobby. (It’s an annual awards ceremony, voted on by the community, with two members being recognised in this way each year. It is already helping further publicise my reviews – both outside the guild and beyond the boundaries of the website.)

As well as my activity on BoardGameGeek, I’ve recently been approached by two other gaming sites interested in hosting and supporting my writing; I have just joined the team at Tabletop United to extend my readership further. I promote my writing on Facebook, through around a dozen gaming groups, as well as Twitter (@A_deck_of_51) – where I am currently close to 1200 followers, so far. Towards the end of last year, I created an Instagram account (deck_of_51) as another avenue to promote my work; I enjoy over 3000 followers, as of today. (I average over 20000 interactions (likes, comments, etc.), per month, via Instagram alone.)

Hi William,
since you pointed out that you are new to backing projects I will take a little more time and try to explain the whole situation a little more extensive.
This campaign (if we take the game versions in different languages out of the equation) is fullfilled in two waves. On the campaign page the Items are labeled with two different categories: "Reprint" and "New Wave". Reprint is the overhauled version of everything that was already available during the initial Kickstarter Campaign for Chronicles of Drunagor in late 2019. Items from the Reprint Category can potentially ship during fullfillment Wave 1. Then there is "New Wave" which is all the new Stuff including the Apocalypse Expansion and some more new Addons. These items are part of fullfillment Wave 2. Handling a large game with a lot of expansions in two shipping waves is by the way more or less the norm and happens for almost all campaigns with a similar scope in available products.
Now apart from that there are usually also two different shipping options that go along with campaigns that fullfill in two waves. This is the single-wave shipping and two-waves shipping. Single-Wave shipping means, that all of your items are shipped in a single shipment. If you only have Wave 1 items in your pledge it will be shipped during Wave 1, but if you also have Wave 2 items (or only Wave 2 items) in your pledge it will be shipped during Wave 2 when everything is available. Two-wave shipping however means that your shipment will also be divided into two shipments. This choice only makes sense if you have items from both Wave 1 and Wave 2 and in that case you will receive your Wave 1 items during Wave 1 fullfillment and the Wave 2 items during Wave 2 fullfillment.
I hope I didn't overwhelm you with this explanation. Now coming back to your specific case. Your pledge contains items from the "Reprint" and also "New Content" category and you have picked the "Single-wave" shipping option. As explained above this means that you will receive all of your items as a single shipment during fullfillment Wave 2.
I hope this answers your question. If you have any further inquiries or anything else we can assist you with, please do not hesitate to contact us again.
Best regards,

Old school D and D player in the day and looking to do solo playing with this game after 40 year absent. Is the 2
nd
printing different from the original?
I read about sleeve cards. Are those separate?
Do you play the expansions after the core game, during the core game or does it matter?

Hi Dave,
​
the 2nd Printing or as we call it Reprint version is more than the name would make you think. It's more like a 1.5 Version of the original game. The campaign (level design, story, ...) was overhauled significantly from the 1.0 version. Also more monster variety has been introduced by different behaviours for all the monsters in the game among some other fixes. So i would either try to get my hands on the 1.5 Version directly, but there is also the option to get the 1.0 version (if you can get it cheaply) and buy the update pack which will convert a 1.0 version into the 1.5 version.
​
The game can be played true solo, which means you control a single hero. But although that is technically possible i would not recommend it. You are missing out on a lot of potential for strategy and also possibilities for using synergies between your heroes. I would recommend playing at least two handed solo, so controlling two heroes. The hero phase in this game is not that long so playing two handed solo is actually not that hard. I know many solo players that play it three or even four-handed.
​
Card sleeves are a way to protect your cards from damage due to shuffling or dirt etc. The concept stems from Trading Card Games (like Magic: The Gathering) but in the recent years also found its way into the boardgame hobby. The sleeves are basically small plastic bags (which are closed on three sides and open on one side and where you can slide the card into and that fit the card pretty snugly. They are most common for games with cards that are shuffled very often. During the crowdfunding campaign packs of sleeves that fit the cards in the game were offered. These are not sold in retail, but there are a lot of brands that sell card sleeves that match. The size the cards in Chronicles of Drunagor have is called "Mini American" and is 43 x 65mm.
There are currently two types of story expansions (excluding the Apocalypse Expansion which is a big expansion that comes with it's own campaign). Those are the regular expansions (Desert of Hellscar, Rise of the Undead Dragon) and the Adventure Packs (The Ruin of Luccanor, The Shadow World). The adventure packs are more like an optional sidequest. You can play them if you have them at a certain point during the Corebox Campaign. The adventurebook will tell you when you can branch off to those. The two large expansions however are played after the Corebox Campaign. If you have both first Hellscar then Undead Dragon.
Table size: The maximum area for the dungeon is 84 x 56 cm and the Adventure Book will tell you where to place the initial setup so you do not have to move around the dungeon later on. You get a diagram like this along every initial setup:
But obviously that is only the space required for the dungeon itself. Apart from that you also need space for the hero area(s) and also space for some other things like the initiative track, the monster status boards and potentially some trays to have easier access to components during the game. My recommendation would be at least a 150 x 80 cm table, bigger obviously better. I usually use a sidetable for the trays and stuff i need to access during the game, but with a big table you can of course also put that to the side of the main table. To get a sense of what the game looks like on the table I would take a look at the BGG page especially the image section. While most of the pictures there are painted minis there are also some gameplay situations where you can see people sitting at a table playing the game. That should give you a basic idea of the required tablespace. Here is the link to BGG:
https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/268012/chronicles-drunagor-age-darkness/images?pageid=1

Hi Mike,
thank you soo much for the kind words. Usually we only get a lot of issues and complaints and problems with delivery etc from customers, but it's very rare that they will express directly how pleased they are with the game. But for us at the end of the day that is the most important thing, that the customer is happy with what we have created and that they enjoy the game just as much as we do. So thank you again.
Just a quick question on the side, since you got the game from retail, did you get the 1.0 version or the new Reprint Edition of the game. The items we sell in our webstore are all the new Reprint (1.5) edition of the game but retailers might still sell the old version and if you mix those you will have compatibility issues. The easiest way to check which version of the game (and expansions) you have is to look at the barcodes on the bottom of the boxes. If the Text above the Barcode has a V2 at the end its the Reprint edition, if it doesn't then its still the old version. In case you have the old version there is an update pack available in our webstore as well that lets you update the old corebox and all expansions to the new edition. Having the new edition is also a prerequisite for being able to play the apocalypse expansion.
Here is an example this is what the barcode of the old corebox looks like. The new one will have V2 at the end of the text and also another year in the copyright etc.

Hi Michael,
thank you for reaching out to us. I can surely help to ease your confusion and there is no shame in admitting that you are confused. To be honest this campaign was so complex and had so many moving parts that it sometimes is even confusing for us. But lets get to the topic. I checked your order and everything is perfectly alright. Shipping has been paid, pledge is finalized and everything. The only minor issue i noticed where I am not sure if this was intentional is that you only included a sleeve pack for the Reprint (which is basically one half of your pledge) but no sleeve pack for the "New Content" (Wave 2). But maybe you don't intend do sleeve each and every card and only the ones that are handled regularly, in that case a single sleeve pack will be plenty.
The reason why you haven't received anything yet is that you picked single wave shipment for your order. Single wave shipment means that all of the items in your pledge are fullfilled in one single big shipment (as opposed to two wave shipment where the items from Wave 1 are shipped during Wave 1 and the ones from Wave 2 come later with Wave 2). Since your Master All In pledge obviously contains items from both Waves in your case this means you will get all of your items (I hope you have a basic idea of the amount that is to be expected) during Wave 2 when all items in your pledge are available. The last update on Gamefound contained some informations regarding the extended Quality Assurance phase for Wave 2 material and at this moment our estimate is that Wave 2 will finish production and leave China in late Q1/2023 and the fullfillment will happen during Q2/2023. But those are currently only estimates because we are dependent on the factory to finish production in time and also sea freight is not yet as predictable again as it was a few years ago. So you can expect updates regarding the timeline for Wave 2 in the upcoming updates on Gamefound as soon as we can give any more precise information.
Hope this helps to clear up your confusion and if not or there is anything else I can help you with feel free to reach out again.
Best regards,

Moin Oliver,
dass du bisher noch nichts bekommen hast liegt daran, dass du das Spiel auf deutsch gebacked hast. Die Sprachversionen erscheinen immer erst einige Monate nach den jeweiligen Englischen Gegenstücken. Das Deutsche Language Pack was du ausgewählt hast um dein bereits vorhandenes Spiel auf 1.5 Level zu bringen und die Sprachbehafteten Komponenten auf Deutsch ist Bestandteil der Language Wave 1. Da gehe ich momentan davon aus, dass die Produktion Ende Q1/2023 abgeschlossen ist und die Auslieferung an Backer im Q2/2023 erfolgt. Das sind bisher aber nur Schätzungen. Voraussetzung dafür ist, dass die 3 Sprachpartner (Deutsch, Französisch, Spanisch) ihre finalen Files rechtzeitig abliefern, so dass wir den Produktionsslot in China nicht verpassen. Und dann muss natürlich auch die Produktion noch reibungslos laufen und auch die Seefracht ist momentan noch nicht wieder so planbar wie das vor Corona war. Sobald es Neuigkeiten zur Timeline gibt werden wir das in Updates auf der Gamefound Seite bekanntgeben. Ich fürchte also ein wenig Geduld ist noch notwendig. Ich habe viele der deutschen Sachen von Frosted Games aber schon gesichtet bzw. noch Anmerkungen dazu abgegeben und das sieht soweit sehr gut aus. Also man kann sich durchaus auf die Deutsche Version freuen.
Best regards,

According to our developing team, it is possible to play using base game plus expansions in different version, but is not advised.
Therefore, the update pack would be the match aiming to avoid this risk of desconection between these versions. Besides that, it is a possibility to explore a new adventure, since these updates allowed these new version to transform the previous game experience in another level.

During your journey in Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness, the Adventure Book will provide you with hooks (designated moments) to play the expansion content without affecting your progress in the main story.

Learning New Hero Skills and Acquiring New Action Cubes (
Rulebook pages 50-51
)
AoD Skills are separated into three categories: Initial Skills (which the characters start the game with); Level 1 Skills; and Level 2 Skills. Skills are learned progressively: that is, you cannot learn a Level 2 Skill if you have not yet learned the Level 1 Skill of that same type. Dungeon Roles are also included in this rule.
Hero Skill Rewards have a specific Skill Level. Heroes can't choose, for example, to learn a Hero Skill Level 1 when they are supposed to learn a Hero Skill Level 2 or vice versa. When learning a new Hero Skill, the Hero also receives a new
Action Cube that matches the color of that Skill's Type, even if that Skill is Passive. That is, if they choose to learn a Melee Skill, they will receive a yellow Action Cube and add it to their player board.
When a Hero learns a new Dungeon Role Skill, they may choose the color of the cube they want to receive instead, which can be of any color. If you later choose to change your Dungeon Role, you may also change the color of the cube you received. So, note on your Campaign Log which color you have chosen.
This sequencing for learning skills was programmed according to the difficulty established in the evolution of the main story. If when you receive a new lvl 1 skill you choose to unlock and use lvl 2, this may cause a strange experience (making the game easier or more difficult).
​

Hi Tom,
​
Clarifications:
"i keep reading pets and i understand it but no where says what pets you can have. granted some say but the effects that just activate your pet can be any is that right? so how do i divide them at the start do i pick some or is it like a first come first serve pool of all not picked? if my teammate has a pet out and i want to activate it it just dispells and is played near me right?

Quoting from the Rulebook (page 09)
Whenever an effect allows a Hero to activate a Pet they may choose to summon a Pet instead of activating one. Also, effects
that activate a Pet come with a instructions to activate a specific Pet or just a general command. Whenever the effect specifies which Pet must be activated, you must follow its instructions.
Otherwise, if the effect just instructs you to "Activate one of your Pets," it means that you can activate any Pet of your
choice.
Have as "your" for the skill text a pet that the Hero has previously summoned.
Example:
Maya with the skill Coordinated Strike, can summon any Pet from the pool, while with the skill Whistle Blow it specifies to activate the Wolf or the Eagle pet.
If a pet is already in play, summoned by another Hero, Maya with the skill Coordinated Strike will not be able to activate the pet summoned by the other Hero. After all, that pet is not "yours", Maya's, since she didn't summon it.
What differs for example from the skills of Hero Savron (Druid - Spoils of War) where Savron's skill - Nature's Aid (for example) says: Activate a pet of your choice.
"lastly is class cards. i understand them until they level up. if i go to level 2 on a class card i pick 1 of the 2 different level 2 abilities is that right?"
That's right. Whenever there is the reward where a Hero unlocks a Class Ability, you can choose whether it will be Lv 1, 2, or 3. However, if a card carries a Lv 1 Class Ability and two other Lv 2 ones, you will need to unlock the Lv 1 of this card to access a Lv 2 one. Yes, you can get both Lv2 Class Abilities in this case.
Each class has only one card with the evolution of Class Ability up to Lv 3, being necessary to unlock Lv 1 and Lv 2 of this card to unlock Lv 3.
"so can i pick the other later somehow? and if i am at level 2 or in that one card level 3 do i still have the lower levels active or are they replaced?"
All unblocked Class Abilities remain active and are not replaced, unless something says otherwise and if there are similar bonuses, they add up (in case you make a multi-class Hero).

Hail Tom,
​
Answering your questions:
1) rewords say learn a "level1 skill"... can i learn an upgrade in that way. like not add a new level 1 card but instead flip it to level 2?
We strongly recommend that you do not do this, as the rewards are balanced with the progression of the game difficulty during the main story. By doing so, you may negatively influence your experience on some level.
2) learning new roles and ability cards give me cubes. do i get 1 new cube per listed skill on the card or is it 1 cube per card always?
As described in Rulebook pages 50/51, you will earn one cube per Skill learned, not one cube per card.
3) it says differently in all instruction how to start your role of choice and no picture on how it looks. what do i do to start dungeon role cards? no one is saying the same thing on this. i need a very broken down layout of this setup. currently i am doing it like this... it says reward to get 1 role card. i started with 0 then picked a role when i added the first card. i changed the order on the track to match any changes. i added 1 cube per card added. i have 1 hero with 1 role card at level 1 and the other hero with 0 and it is chapter 5. this seems like i did it wrong.
As described on Rulebook page 08 as well as exemplified in Step 4 of Start Here!, each hero present in the adventure will start the game and future chapters with cards I and II of the Dungeon Role chosen for him.
In an example with 2 players: Player A chooses Vorn and the Dungeon Role Defender. He will start with Vorn's starter set and the 2 Dungeon Role Defender cards, cards I and II. Player B chooses Elros and the Dungeon Role Striker. He will start with the Elros starting set, and the 2 Dungeon Role Striker cards, cards I and II.
Note that these 2 initial Dungeon Role cards will not give any extra cubes to the Hero. Heroes will only receive new Action Cubes when they unlock new levels of Hero Skills or Dungeon Role Skill (the ones on card III that we left out at the beginning of the game).

Hi there,

We’re reaching out to let you know that a security vulnerability was discovered in the WooCommerce Payments and WooCommerce Subscriptions extensions, and a patch has been deployed to address it. You received this email because you use one or both of these extensions.

This patch applies to all versions of WooCommerce Payments since 4.2.0 and all versions of WooCommerce Subscriptions since 2.1.0. If exploited in a certain way, these vulnerabilities could have allowed unauthorized users to access limited, non-payment-related information about unpaid guest orders.

No evidence of an external breach has been detected. As soon as we discovered this vulnerability, we immediately developed and deployed a patch.


** What do I need to do?
------------------------------------------------------------

If your store is hosted on WordPress.com, both of the extensions are being updated automatically to remove the vulnerability.

If your store is not hosted on WordPress.com, we strongly recommend that you ensure you're using the latest, secure version of the WooCommerce Payments and WooCommerce Subscriptions extensions:

* From your site’s WordPress Admin dashboard, click the Plugins menu item and look for WooCommerce Payments and/or WooCommerce Subscriptions in your list of plugins.

For WooCommerce Payments

* The version numbers should be displayed in the Description column next to the plugin name. If your version of WooCommerce Payments is 5.9.1, no further action is needed.
* If your version is lower than 5.9.1, you may see a notice guiding you to update WooCommerce Payments — please go ahead and do so.
* If you don’t see a notice, you can download the latest version from your WooCommerce.com account dashboard (https://woocommerce.com/my-account/downloads/?utm_source=%5BSIRT%5D+WCPAY+and+WooCommerce+Subscriptions+%E2%80%93%C2%A06+June+2023&utm_campaign=9f1dedbdcd-sirt_stripe_june_2023_wcpay_wcsubscriptions&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-acca309ecb-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D&mc_cid=9f1dedbdcd&mc_eid=UNIQID) .
* If your version is between 3.2.0 and 4.1.1, you need to manually update WooCommerce Payments to one of these fixed versions:
+ 5.9.1
+ 5.8.2
+ 5.7.1
+ 5.6.3

**For WooCommerce Subscriptions

* The version numbers should be displayed in the Description column next to the plugin name. If your version of WooCommerce Subscriptions is 5.1.3, no further action is needed.
* If your version is between 2.1.0 and 5.1.2, you may see a notice guiding you to update WooCommerce Subscriptions — please go ahead and do so.
* If you don’t see a notice, you can download the latest version from your WooCommerce.com account dashboard (https://woocommerce.com/my-account/downloads/?utm_source=%5BSIRT%5D+WCPAY+and+WooCommerce+Subscriptions+%E2%80%93%C2%A06+June+2023&utm_campaign=9f1dedbdcd-sirt_stripe_june_2023_wcpay_wcsubscriptions&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-acca309ecb-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D&mc_cid=9f1dedbdcd&mc_eid=UNIQID)


** Has my data been compromised?
------------------------------------------------------------

Dear ,



We are Manufacturers of Board games and Playing card Games based in Mumbai,
India. We are known as The   T. M. Playing Card Manufacturing Co. (India)
and TMCARDS DOT COM. With over 45 Years of personal experience and 52 years
of the Company’s existence in the manufacture of Playing Cards and board
games, we have developed a deep understanding of the industry and the
unique challenges that come with it. Our expertise in game mechanics,
prototyping, production, and distribution has helped us to create and
manufacture quite a few Card and Board Games for our discerning clients
globally.



As for the plastic components we have close ties with die makers and have
our own plastic molding machines close to 100 km away from us.



We are passionate about Manufacturing Board games and Playing Cards for the
US and UK as of now as a silent back end manufacturer. Since we are
vertically integrated and have our own processes in-house it

becomes easier to control quality and take decisions on the same. We take
pride in delivering products that comply with the specifications and
sometimes exceed our clients' expectations and ourselves too at times.



We also provide pre order sampling with a rider that 50% of the sampling
costs are adjusted and deducted with the confirmation of the order.



We have an installed optimum capacity to produce 120000 decks of playing
cards daily.



Manufacturing in India has its own veritable advantages over the
manufacturing costs which result in a greater profit for the overseas
clients.  We are always open to connecting with publishers, designers,
distributors, and anyone else in the Playing card and Board gaming industry
who shares our passion for existing games or the new ones. So, if you're
looking to collaborate on a new project or an existing one, feel free to
reach out over costs or any concerns and we will answer ASAP. Let's connect
and see if there is any mutual benefit in getting together to help with the
manufacturing in India.



To give you an insight we are vertically integrated having our own design
team and studio as pre-press and Post Press Heidelberg CP Tronic printing
machines, automatic playing card punching, Coating Lamination, Box Making,
die punching, stitching, auto carton pasting machines and lots more that is
needed to complete all the processes in house.  If you have any specific
query please feel free to get back to us.



Thanking you,

Subject: June News from CGS

		  View this email in your browser [1]

		   [2]

 JUNE NEWS FROM CGS

	 Hi,  

		 We hope you're doing great! We'd like to welcome you to this new
iteration of the CGS newsletter that you can read to stay on top of
the most important news from our studio, from the CGS community, and
new content that we create.

		 We'll take a look at what's happening with  Chronicles of Drunagor:
Apocalypse [3] as well as the upcoming  DANTE: The Invasion of Hell
[4]. On top of that, we'll show you a new series of CGS: Spotlight
articles (the first one is on storytelling [5]) and a  new community
discussion with a giveaway [6].

		   [7]

 DANTE: THE INVASION OF HELL

		 _In a world of corruption and despair, a group of heroes is thrust
into a world beyond their wildest imagination as they embark on a path
like no other. The fabled poet himself once wandered through these
depths, and now it is his turn to be the guide. This is Dante's
Inferno, and it will take you on a journey you will never forget._

		 In the second project update, we explore how the idea to bring
Inferno to the board game medium developed, and we look at what makes
the game unique by sharing the core principles that govern our design
decisions behind each of the two game phases, the Narrative
Exploration and the Confrontation.

		  Read the Latest Update on Gamefound [8]

		   [9]

 CHRONICLES OF DRUNAGOR: APOCALYPSE

		 In the latest project update, we talk about the news in the
production progress for the Language Reprint and the English version
of Apocalypse, but on top of that, we also wanted to give you a
behind-the-scenes look into the history of the development process of
CoD "reprint" and Apocalypse.

		  Read the Latest Update on Gamefound [10]

 WHAT'S COD AND APOCALYPSE?

		 _Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness _is a cooperative dungeon
crawler for 1-5 players. The game is based on 3D scenarios, each of
them played separately or on a continuous storyline. Fight monsters
while unraveling amazing interactions and treasures.

		 _Apocalypse_ is a massive expansion that brings another chapter in
the fight Darkness. Unravel Drunagor's culture and mythology in an
enhanced campaign development experience where your choices will
change the adventures you will face and decide the way the story will
end.

		 If you have missed the last CoD crowdfunding campaign, you can
order both from the CGS webstore. (Note that _Apocalypse_ is currently
in production).

		  Order Both CoD and Apocalypse on CGS Webstore [11]

		   [12]

 CGS SPOTLIGHT: (WORLD)BUILDING A STORY

		 CGS Spotlight is a new series of articles going deeper into board
game-related topics based on interviews with our team members. In the
first one, we’d love to talk about storytelling, and the ideal
person to talk about it was Mauro, the lead developer of Apocalypse
and Dante, responsible for not only the gameplay mechanics but also
for the narrative design, creative writing, and the overall direction
of the game.

		 Check out the way Mauro approaches storytelling in board games as
he talks about the importance of worldbuilding and his goals when
developing and expressing a game narrative. Also, did you know that
Mauro was (a kind of) modern professional version of the DnD Wizard
class?

		  Read (World)Building a Story [13]

		   [14]

 COMMUNITY DISCUSSION WITH A GIVEAWAY

		 We’d also like to get to know you a bit better, and we’d love
to know what you think. That’s why we’d like to start this
discussion in which you can share your thoughts on different aspects
of board gaming and also learn what other people think. To do this,
we’ll set a survey that will eventually be turned into a short
article with a summary of the results.

		 To show you that we appreciate that you share your thoughts, WE
WILL GIVE AWAY A PLEDGE FROM THE UPCOMING DANTE CAMPAIGN to one random
person who participates.

		 Now, we are sure that there are many solo gamers among you, so the
topic for the first community discussion is easy for us to choose. Let
us know your thoughts on gaming solo! Do you like to challenge fierce
automas? Do you prefer playing true solo or do you usually control
multiple characters? And even if you hate playing alone, come let us
and others know!

It didn’t hold her for long, but the experience was enough for her spirit to find its true calling. This event will take place on the 28th and 29th of October and is part of the "Play more to be better" project, promoted by Sê Mais Sê Melhor with the support of various entities, such as the Portuguese Youth and Sports Institute, the Town Hall, FNAC, Schools, Youth associations, and others.     The profits from this event will support the non-profit association's projects, including work with over 1,000 children and youth in terms of Equality, Gender Violence, Human Rights, Motivation, Education, and Entrepreneurship.     The AlgarveCON 2022 received support from dozens of entities and was pleased to welcome approximately 300 participants. It featured a library of over 400 board games and a multitude of activities, such as Dungeons and Dragons, Dungeon and Dragons for Juniors, Worldbuilding Workshop, Miniature Painting, Game Presentations, Prototype Demonstrations, Warhammer 40K, and Magic the Gathering.     We would like to ask for your help in making this year's event even better by donating one or more board games for the prize draw.     In return, we will promote your brand at the event through posters across the Algarve, press releases, and the Instagram and Facebook platforms of the event, the MTG Club Olhão, and the Sê Mais Sê Melhor Association pages. Additionally, you will be recognized as a brand that supports the work carried out by the non-profit Association Sê Mais Sê Melhor.     We appreciate a prompt response considering the urgency in building the image and marketing of the event.     Thank you very much, and best regards,  Martina (she/her)  AlgarveCON Team

Appreciate the follow up! I snagged the master all in with the ez pay system.
I enjoyed following the campaign and your guys’ journey so much I figured I’d give you some personalized positive feedback….which I never do. I’m sure running a crowdfunded campaign of this size is a massive, stressful, undertaking and maintaining focus on good business decisions is admirable
- The EZ pay system was an excellent business decision. I hope this becomes a persistent option for all future crowdfunded games with a high price point. Hats off to y’all for starting something new and great!
- The decision to adjust the original game for this campaign based off of feedback shows a genuine pursuit of excellence and a passion for the actual, final end user product that will be worth it’s weight in gold for y’all’s future.
- A concern I’ve developed after back some 50+ board game kickstarters…..it’s easy to “half-ass” the final bits of game development for many legitimate reasons. Stay strong through the whole process and dig deep when times get tough. I’ve served 16 years as a Green Beret and these moments are always the most character defining situations…..this applies to companies as much as it does to me when I’m in a shitty situation in a foreign war-zone
- in my personal humble opinion as an avid, very experienced dungeon crawler fanatic….the biggest enemies of a top notch dungeon crawler are; repetitiveness (feeling Grindy), lack of depth, and a lackluster experience while “in the dungeon”. Maybe some good things to keep in mind during the game development
- The current gaming culture; gear, rewards and character development. It seems the worlds gaming culture (and our culture in general) has evolved to where these above stated things are what defines the quality and a large part of the experience of gaming. I don’t necessarily agree with this, or personally need it but, I think if you guys skin this cat well you’ll get overwhelming positive feedback. I think you’re already on the right track with the stretch goals provided.
Anyways, I just wanted to provide some candid feedback in the hopes it maybe helps provide a little extra fuel to the already brightly burning fire you guys have for this game. I appreciate your hard work, dedication and constant pursuit of excellence. I know this is going to be an extremely stressful next 18-24 months for you guys…..stay strong and don’t settle for mediocrity!!!!!
Josh

texto_original:
Hello, My name is José Alberto, and I'm contacting you for an issue about
the game Chronicles of Drunagor.

I received the product for the Kickstarter campaign but I couldn't play it
a lot. Recently, I saw that the manual says there are three Rune cards, and
I have only two, a rune card with two faces and a Undead King Rune card. I
need to know if there was an error in the manual, because I have never seen
the third card. If there aren't errors, I want to complain about a
replacement for that card.

My address is:

José Alberto Muñoz Carrillo
C\ Orden de Malta, 13, CP 41309
La Rinconada, Sevilla

Thanks
respostas:
Hi José Alberto,
We thank you for your support and apologize for any confusion you may have encountered with the rune cards and for the delay in getting back to you.
You are absolutely correct; the manual indeed mentions three Rune cards. However, I'd like to clarify that there are not three distinct physical Rune cards. Instead, the Rune cards are represented as follows:
Double-faced Rune Card
: This physical card consists of two faces, and each face counts as one Rune Card. So, in total, you have two Rune Cards with this single physical card.
Undead King Haunting Rune Card
: This physical card is the Undead King Rune Card, and it has two identical faces. Even though it has two faces, it counts as just one Rune Card.
Therefore, you have a total of three Rune Cards, as indicated in the manual. We hope this clears up any confusion.
Once again, we appreciate your support and patience, and we're here to ensure that you have the best possible experience with CoD.
Kind regards,
Nei

Hi Rick,


First of all, I'm sorry to have been away for so long. The last two years have been quite busy (with good times and one other unfortunately bad), putting the translation project on hold... I'm sorry about that...

Moreover, I haven't had any news from the other translators since autumn 2021...


Concerning the situation at the time of our last exchanges: we had completed the translation of the rules booklet as well as the adventure booklet (I recently noticed a dragon color error in an event that I'll be correcting shortly) and the doors to the first 5 chapters.


Since your last e-mail of this summer, I've resumed the translation project (alone). Unfortunately, I didn't reply immediately, as I wanted to come back to you with progress and not just words. So I've finished the layout of all the CoreBox doors and I'm currently translating the Interactions Book. Currently, I've translated the text boxes and I'm going over the images on each page to transfer the event titles from the Adventure Book.

As soon as it's finished, I'll let you know how it's laid out.


You will find here the translated documents (and those to come):
https://www.dropbox.com/sh/ccs5d89iv9sup46/AAAG2sxsdFH2aofPpDVZB2J8a?dl=0
(Although I proofread and use a spell-checker before exporting, it's possible that a few typos remain...)


Once the Interaction Book is finished, would you have a preference as to the priority (or logical sequence) of the next element to be translated? I was considering "Start Here" or "Player Board", but perhaps an expansion adventure would be more important to translate first?


(Regarding "Player Board", I couldn't find the source files on DropBox: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/iyztqo5swlhu75e/AAB5s3hU3CnBgREVS2DVuSYOa/Corebox/Player%20Board?dl=0&lst= , is that normal?)


Again: I'm sorry for this long absence, and I'll try to continue at the best possible pace. I'll keep you informed.


Best regards,

Dorian
