Hi ​Bruce,
​
I hope this message finds you in good spirits. We few sorry about the Essen meeting, next year our team will be on Gencon and Essen, let's try meet there.
But for the other side, our company is currently in touch with approximately 70 factories interested in product our games . However, we are delighted to recognize your factory as one of the select few that align with our production needs. We firmly believe that our shared commitment to excellence can serve as the cornerstone for a prosperous partnership, similar to the successful ones we've fostered.
To ensure that we make well-informed decisions in building our production partnerships, we are actively collecting vital information to gain a deeper understanding of our potential partners, including the desire to update our existing knowledge. 3. Employee Count: Kindly provide us with information on the total number of employees at your facility.
4. Project Lead Time: We are interested in understanding the typical duration for completing projects at your factory.
It's important to emphasize that we assess potential partners based on several fundamental criteria for our business:
1. Final Product Quality: We hold a steadfast commitment to the highest quality for our games and will settle for nothing less.
2. Clear Project Management: We value well-organized project management, including a G-sheet with all delivery milestones and project stages. It should be regularly updated and linked to relevant photos and videos.
3. Effective Communication: Efficient communication and collaboration, whether through WhatsApp or Discord, is of paramount importance to us.
4. Consistency: We expect stability and consistency in our partnerships to minimize disruptions.

Fernando Costa says:



Fernando Costa

Hello to everyone at Creative Games Studio, my name is Ronald Halliday. I am a friend of Fernando Costa's, and I'm sorry to have to inform you that he passed away suddenly in April 2021. Earlier in the year I started helping his family to organize and catalog his extensive collection of board games, and fortunately we have access to his Kickstarter account to follow up on projects that fulfilled after his passing.



Since I did not find a copy of Chronicles of Drunagor: AoD in Fernando's collection, I took a look at the campaign updates. From what I read in updates #92 and #94, the game was going to be shipped to Brazil right when he passed away, which explains why it didn't arrive. It's possible that Fernando wasn't able to reply to the message sent by Quartermaster and his copy wasn't sent. Or his game was sent, and may have been returned because the import duties went unpaid.



Would it be possible to check the status of Fernando's order? I'm afraid we don't have access to his email or pledge manager accounts to provide or discover more information on our own.



Thanks for your time, and my apologies for the inconvenience. 

Ron

texto_original: Hi Are,     We are reaching out to you today to explain a few things.     You might know that there have been a massive delay in numerous shipments to Norway on the past months, which made many logistics companies, ShipQuest included, face issues delivering orders. Unfortunately, your order was one of these. The communication we received from QML, who is handling the orders with ShipQuest for us was this: "There are 5 orders for Norway that were originally fulfilled from the EU hub, listed below. Sometime in May, we were made aware of an issue getting them delivered and have been working with the teams to resolve it. Unfortunately, it's not a simple problem with a simple solution and the whole process is taking much longer than we would have liked. We're actively working on a solution for all of the affected orders across several campaigns."     Only recently they have come to us with a proposal for a solution and unfortunately, this solution involves an increase in the shipping rate.  "We cannot deliver using the original method and ShipQuest is covering the equivalent portion to reship. The amount we're asking for here is the difference between the original shipment cost and the new method, which is required for all shipments valued over 1000 NOK. The only option available is to ship through a different carrier, using a service with DDU terms."     The increase in the shipping rate for your pledge is $132.10 as you can see from the email we received from QML below:         Since this is not a solution that we agree on, is the only one they have provided us. Therefore, since this was not what we agreed with you, our backer, we want to open an exception here so that you have at least two options if ShipQuest's solution does not please you.  1) You may pay the difference of $132.10 through PayPal to info@wearecgs.com and we will proceed to issue your parcel to be delivered to you. If you have changed your address, please inform us so that we may communicate our logistics partners. I will start by saying that I will pay the necessary amount, just to get this solved, but I feel the need to explain and complain about this, so please bear with me.
I think it is rather bad of Shipquest - and QML - to blame this on Norway. There has been no relevant change to customs and handling for these kind of shipments since 2004. This is, ironically, a result of Brexit (as there was no problem when Shipquest shipped from the UK (by DHL). The problem is that Shipquest chose to use Postnord as a handler to Norway - Postnord is the only handler who does not have a working system for collecting VAT when importing to Norway. Other handlers (like DHL/Fedex) pay the VAT when importing, and then bill the customer afterwards. The Norwegian Post office (posten.no) have you pay the VAT when you collect the package at the delivery point. Postnord has decided to only prepay VAT and collect afterwards for packages worth less than 1000 kr, and does not have any way to pay as you collect. Therefore, they are not capable of handling these kind of orders, and should not have offered there services to Shipquest, nor, to be honest, should Shipquest have entered into a contract with them to deliver packages to Norway. This is THEIR mistake, not mine, nor the Norwegian custom's.
Thus I would ask you to make sure that Shipquest will have solved this issue before you deliver on the Apocalypse expansion, and I would like to know that if I am paying more, that all of this + the original amount payed for shipping goes to cover the new handler's costs, and that none of it goes to Postnord for not doing their job.
Anyway, I will pay the amount through Paypal once I hear back from you on this message.
Regards,
Are Skei

Hi Benjamin Pheline,
Thank you for your contact and support for CoD.
To clarify your question, whenever a condition is stackable, it will form a pile of that condition.
For example the Burn condition, which can accumulate up to 4 tokens, forming a maximum pile of 4.
Arkhanos' Agility 3 Hero Skill - Bonfire Dance, allows you to perform Jump 6 and then, if there is an enemy with the Burn condition, trigger it once. In other words, deal damage equal to the number of tokens of Burn stacked (pile) on an enemy and then remove one of those tokens.
This skill allows you to activate an enemy's Burn condition during the Hero's turn, which would normally only be activated at the start of the affected monster's turn.
I hope I've helped.
If you have any questions, please feel free to get in touch.
​Warm regards,

Hello Creative Games Studio, 

My name is Bryce Henderson and I am a teacher at Dr. Roy Wilson Learning Centre in Medicine Hat, Alberta Canada. I currently run an after school Board Game Club for students in our school, as well as a Modern Board Gaming Electives Course where we look at game design and study various different mechanisms found in today’s modern gaming. 

Since we do not have a budget or any funding allocated to this, we are only able to run this amazing opportunity for students by reaching out to wonderful companies and publishers to see if they would be willing to support us by donating games to help grow the passion of gaming in our students! 

I am reaching out to your company to see if you would have interest in helping support out club by possibly donating a pledge of DANTE: Inferno. The students in my class and School Game Club absolutely ADORE Chronicles of Drunagor and they are in love with narrative driven, boss battler games. texto_original:
Hello,
My group is about to start Apocalypse in a couple of weeks and was hoping to get some feedback on a couple of things. 

If I have a class skill for +1 health does that apply to Fruits of life and Drain?

Also on Drain if you do a cleave attack and drained from 2 targets and was using the Shaman skill Counterbalance can you apply poison to each target or just one target?

If you are using a fully upgraded Ultimate Shell Opener on cleave attack and both die do you get 1 or 2 focus?

Last one, Catharina the mage is using Blood Curse and enemy does not die and activates. Does the player control monster or does monster take a turn? The monster is not immune to stun.

Thanks again for all your insight on theses and all the other questions you have answered. Have a great day!
Sent from my iPhone
respostas:
Hello
Just was checking on my email.
Thanks
Dennis

Hi Dennis Walker,
I apologize for the delay in getting back to you.
Let's go:
If I have a class skill for +1 health does that apply to Fruits of life and Drain?
No. The passive effect mentioned is applied when the skill contains the keyword HEAL.
There are specific effects that affect the amount of life recovered when using a Fruits of Life or Drain, for example.
The life recovered by the Fruits of Life/Drain effect are not considered to be the keyword HEAL, for the skills trigger aspect.
Also on Drain if you do a cleave attack and drained from 2 targets and was using the Shaman skill Counterbalance can you apply poison to each target or just one target?
​In this case, you won't be able to POISON anyone, because DRAIN doesn't trigger the HEAL keyword. What's more, the target of HEAL would be the Shaman, not the character being targeted. Therefore, you could choose to apply POISON to yourself, which makes no sense. This Skill is used to turn a normally defensive SKILL into an offensive one.
If you are using a fully upgraded Ultimate Shell Opener on cleave attack and both die do you get 1 or 2 focus?
​
2 Focus. CLEAVE faz o Ataque atingir dois alvos, assim, ele pode desencadear 1 vez para cada alvo atingido.
Last one, Catharina the mage is using Blood Curse and enemy does not die and activates. Does the player control monster or does monster take a turn? The monster is not immune to stun.
The monster is controlled by its AI. Activate is the command given to a monster to take a turn as if the Initiative Marker had arrived on its card.
​
I hope I've been able to help you with these answers. They were the explanations given by the CoD developer.
If you have any other questions or anything else we can help you with, please feel free to get in touch.
Sincerely,
Nei Mendonça

texto_original: Dear Creative Games,  I hope this letter finds you well. My name is Olivier St-Hilaire, and I am writing on behalf of Belfountain Public School, located in the charming town of Belfountain, Ontario. Our school caters to approximately 200 students ranging from Kindergarten to Grade 6.  We are contacting you with a special request that aligns with your company's commitment to fostering education and recreational activities. At Belfountain Public School, our thriving Board Game Club has gained immense popularity among our students. It has become a beloved pastime, especially during recess, providing a unique and engaging way for students of all ages to interact and develop essential social skills.  Our Board Game Club currently operates with a limited collection of games, most of which have been generously donated by parents. However, the overwhelming interest from our students has resulted in crowded game sessions, with as many as 100 students participating in the gym during recess. Unfortunately, our current inventory is insufficient to accommodate this growing demand, and we need additional board games to enhance the experience for our students.  The socio-economic conditions of our community present a challenge, as many of our students and their families cannot afford many leisure activities, let alone donate to our school. Additionally, the school budget does not allow for the purchase of additional games to meet the needs of our expanding Board Game Club.  Recognizing your company's commitment to supporting educational initiatives and community development, we kindly request your assistance in donating one or more board games suitable for Kindergarten to Grade 6 students. Your contribution will enrich the Board Game Club experience and contribute to our student's overall well-being and social development.  We understand the value of fostering a positive learning environment and appreciate your consideration of this request. If you have any questions or require further information, please contact me at 905-586-1117.  Thank you for your time and consideration. We look forward to collaborating with you to provide our students a more enjoyable and educational Board Game Club experience.  Sincerely,  Olivier St-Hilaire, OCT  Grade 2 Teacher  Belfountain Public School  17247 Shaws Creek Road  Belfountain, Ontario  L7K 0E8

Dear J Mauricio Hoffman,
My name is Maria Julia Ronzani (but everyone calls me Maju!), and I'm the project manager at CGS. I'm reaching out to personally follow up on your request for a refund for the Apocalypse Dice and Dante: Infernal Pledge Refund.
First, I want to apologize for the delayed response. I understand you're frustrated with the situation, and I want to assure you that we're doing everything we can to make things right.
Let me explain what happened with the Apocalypse Dice:
Unfortunately, the manufacturer we partnered with to produce the dice ended up not fulfilling their agreement. Despite our payments and initial approvals, the samples they sent were of significantly lower quality than what we had originally agreed upon. We couldn't, in good faith, accept those dice.
After many attempts to resolve the issue, the manufacturer informed us they were unable to produce the dice as promised and, unfortunately, did not return our payments or deliver the product. This situation has been incredibly disappointing for us, and we understand how frustrating it is for you as a backer.
To address this, we've been working hard to reach out to everyone who pledged for the Apocalypse Dice to issue refunds. We announced this process in an update on our campaign page on June 19th, 2024, and have been consistently reminding backers to fill out the necessary forms to claim their refunds.
We've been processing refunds since September 1st.  It's been a manual process, with a dedicated member of our team carefully reviewing each case to ensure accuracy, for we don't have any mistakes on the value to be paid to each of you.  As you'll see in our upcoming update this month, we're making good progress on these refunds, and few people have received them by now.
I understand that you may have missed our previous communications. And for people like you, to streamline the process and avoid any further delays, we've established a protocol to pause adding new refund requests after this time at we finish to process.
However, we don't want to leave anyone without a solution. For backers who haven't filled out the form, we're offering refunds in the form of credit on our website or towards your Dante pledge (if you have one). This is what Nei offered you initially, and this will not be for long since we need to finish this part of the project.
I realize that these options might not be ideal for you and I truly empathize with your situation. Nei has been working tirelessly to find alternative solutions, which is why I decided to step in and communicate with you directly.
As an exceptional measure, and just because I find one little opportunity here, I can offer you a refund for the dice specifically via PayPal. Unfortunately, we're unable to process bank transfers or any other refund method at this time.
Regarding your Dante pledge, we're happy to process a refund for that as well. However, we'd like to remind you that this will also end with any gifts you received for backing on the campaign time. Should you decide to back the game again in the future, unfortunately, we won't be able to add the gift again.
Please let Nei know your decision about the Apocalypse Dice refund if you choose the PayPal option by October 27th. We need to add you for the processing on the 28th, but the refund will not be immediate, since I will add you to the end of the list, to be processed, and we will follow the forms refunds as we have done, so you will receive on the refund term and time, not immediately.
If you return after this date, I won't be able to do this by now.
Thank you for your patience and understanding.
Warmly,
Maju Ronzani
Project Manager

We only want to confirm that you are aware of the conditions before proceeding with your request. Once we hear from you we will proceed to issuing your refund as soon as possible.
We would also love to hear your reason to issue the refund as it would be a great help in guiding us towards improving even further what we do.

Dear developers at CGS,     This is Christiano Sensi, I'm a game
writer and a fan of your projects! I'd like to introduce myself in case you
need a writer or creator for any of them (and if there is someone specific I
should get in touch with for that, please advise me).     I'm a writer and producer with ample
background, and during the last few years, I've been mostly a game writer.
I was one of the writers for the fantasy tabletop game Tanares Adventures, as well as one of the writers for Dawn
of Madness, the horror tabletop Kickstarter
project of the creators of Deep Madness (Diemension Games, US-China). I'm
also writing the script for the new digital game for the American-European
developers of Repulse Game Studios.     Before writing for games, I had
diverse creative work experience; in my curriculum, I have staged plays,
published books and filmed scripts. I'm also quite experienced as an executive
producer for creative projects; I was the Cinema and TV Coordinator at Black
Maria Films, a big Brazilian film production company where I led large
audiovisual productions such as 2 Rabbits, Stronger than the World and Solace, and 2 Rabbits' online game. By 2015, I left to pursue my own
projects again and work as a writer, and since 2018 I'm
basically working solely as a creative writer.     Attached I send my CV and a writing
portfolio. It encompasses a wide variety of media, formats and software, and
even some of my freehand drawings to support art direction for games, but you
can use the links on the cover to go straight to samples of your interest,
and take a glance at other works if you like. You can also
check my website (christianosensi.com) for my detailed bio, my IMBb and LinkedIn profiles and my Vimeo page for work samples in audiovisual arts and media –
links are on my CV and on my writing portfolio as well. 
 
Technically, I'm adaptable and eager to learn new formats and techniques, and
I’m always studying and updating my writing skills; I’m also easygoing and
cooperative in teamwork. I also really enjoy that in game writing each
work has its own dynamics, and often times we have to develop a whole new way
of writing, tailor-made for each project. I also think that one
of my important traits in creative writing and project development is
having an inquisitive and restless mind that always pushes me to try to create
something fresh, rather than relying on the beaten path or on easy solutions.   
I've been working remotely primarily, and I'm available for any
adaptations in order to attend work time/quota arrangements. 
Congratulations on your beautiful work. I look forward to your
reply and maybe an opportunity to collaborate on one of your projects. 
 
Thank you very much!   All the best, 
 
Christiano Sensi

texto_original: Hey, On your reset password page, when I enter my email and click reset password, it tells me that "username or email" does not exist in the system.  That information can be used to extract all usernames and passwords from your database. This 'hack' is very easily executable with automated tools (can be done by a kid without skills).   Luckily - it is easy to fix. You should just change the response from the server and on the webpage to say: "If your username or email was in the database, you will receive an email to the registered address with instructions on how to reset your password."  In this way you do not expose any information that allows me to identify whether a given email or username is in the database.  Consider this free security advice, because I really love your game, and would hate to see you being hacked!  Kind regards Henning

Dear Ethan kautz,
 

First, we would like to thank you for supporting Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness Apocalypse.
 

We are reaching out today regarding your EZ Pay registration. We know that some backers had issues with this new system, and despite our efforts, not all of these issues could be solved during the campaign.
 

However, now that the campaign is finished, we had time to look at the registrations and identify those that had some kind of issue while registering for EZ Pay and decided to assist those that want to complete their EZ Pay pledge.
 
In your case, we identified that your EZ Pay registration was not finished successfully, and, therefore, if you still want to keep your pledge, we need you to finalize it.
 
To assist you, we will try to walk you through the process.
 
Please bear in mind that we are doing an exceptional extension on the EZ Pay registration period and we are not sure until when we are able to keep it open. So please, finalize your registration if you want to keep your pledge as soon as possible.
 
Since all is right with your account and order at Gamefound, we just need to set up the EZ Pay part. For that, please follow the steps below:
 
1- Click on this link to go to your pledge level page: https://store.wearecgs.com/product/ez-pay-gameplay-all-in/
 
2- Click on “PAY NOW”;
 
3- Click on “VIEW CART”;


 
4- Then on the new screen click on “PROCEED TO CHECKOUT”;


 
5- On the new screen, fill in your personal information. The email address must be the same as the one on your Gamefound pledge. The same goes for your PLEDGE ID NUMBER. If in doubt, just go to Gamefound and check the status of your pledge before filling out;


 
6- Check your pledge;
 
7- Click on “PAY NOW”.



And that is it! You are now good to go and your next EZ Pay installments will be automatically charged from your credit card.
 
If you do have any questions or doubts during the process or anything else we can assist you with, please do not hesitate to reach out to us at customerservice@wearecgs.com as we can more easily help you from there. Additionally, if your EZ Pay is already registered, please do reach out to us at customerservice@wearecgs.com. To check if you have successfully registered your EZ Pay subscription just click HERE, log in into your account and check under SUBSCRIPTIONS:


Thank you for your attention and your support.

Best regards,



Team CGS

Dear James Rasing,
 

First, we would like to thank you for supporting Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness Apocalypse.
 

We are reaching out today regarding your EZ Pay registration. We know that some backers had issues with this new system, and despite our efforts, not all of these issues could be solved during the campaign.
 

However, now that the campaign is finished, we had time to look at the registrations and identify those that had some kind of issue while registering for EZ Pay and decided to assist those that want to complete their EZ Pay pledge.
 
In your case, we identified that your EZ Pay registration was not finished successfully, and, therefore, if you still want to keep your pledge, we need you to finalize it.

2- Click on “PAY NOW”;
 
3- Click on “VIEW CART”;


 
4- Then on the new screen click on “PROCEED TO CHECKOUT”;


 
5- On the new screen, fill in your personal information. The email address must be the same as the one on your Gamefound pledge. The same goes for your PLEDGE ID NUMBER. If in doubt, just go to Gamefound and check the status of your pledge before filling out;


 
6- Check your pledge;
 
7- Click on “PAY NOW”.



And that is it! You are now good to go and your next EZ Pay installments will be automatically charged from your credit card.
 
If you do have any questions or doubts during the process or anything else we can assist you with, please do not hesitate to reach out to us at customerservice@wearecgs.com as we can more easily help you from there. Best regards,



Team CGS

Hey Marcio,
You can export lots of things in “Orders” tab. Just filter people by “Order contains product”, click the checkbox next to “Order ID”, and then “export” button.
In excel you’d be able to sort/remove backers however you like. Once you have the list of people you want, you need to create one long string od data with their email addresses divided
with commas. Then you click the “Users” tab, and filter people by these addresses (just paste them in the e-mail field). Then, add them to a dedicated user group.
Then, you have two options:
You can make 100% discount for the specific item for people in this group. That’d require you to limit the item “1 per user”,
as if you want them to buy more, the 100% discount would apply to all. All other backers will be able to buy it for the price you set – but only one per user.
If you want to allow people to buy more pieces of this item, you can make two identical items – one for free, with limit “1 per
user”, and visible only to select group, one paid, without limitation, visible for everyone.
Hope that helps.
About list of backers per countries – the best list you’ll get once you start PM, and collect the shipping addresses, but I understand you need an estimation, based on the country of
bank that issued the CC? With this
@Kamila Konecka
can help you.

M.

Thanks for your email.
Sure thing we do have to pay for the EZ PAY commission fee as we have informed to Marcin previously. But based on what he has suggested, could we pay this fee in a recurring basis, since we are experiencing quite a lot of defaults and backers not signing up for the monthly payment quite easily.

I’m sorry to hear about the issues in EZ PAY inflows, hope they do not affect you materially.

15
th
day of the next month. Therefore would be great if you could be sending us the statement by 10
th
, so that we issue an invoice within the deadline. Then we would be sending the invoice to you by 15
th
. Does that sound fine?
Please ignore the invoice I sent you yesterday, we will issue a proper one once you submit the August report.

Michal

Sounds good Michal, thank you very much.
So based on your suggestion I have run the report of August as attached. You can see that the payments with emails and order numbers are in the second sheet.
We did have in August a very low number (~25%) of payments in our system from backers that bought the EZ PAY option because we did give them some time (around 25 days) after they commit with a credit card in our system in order to not charge them twice in the first month since they have paid the deposit on Gamefound on the begin of August.
I am quite confident that this number will grow in September as I have seen for the first half of the month, and also we are mailing every person that has not subscribed to the EZP platform to commit, or else they will lose their deposit and will not receive the game (or will ask for a refund with havier terms). Hi Matthias,
My name is MaJu Ronzani, and I'm the project manager from CGS.
I understand your frustration, but unfortunately, there's nothing we can do about the VAT. That's a tax regulation we can't change. In your case, the VAT is 19% of the total cost of the product plus shipping.
Regarding the free gift (the Dante Poet miniature), the shipping cost for Germany should be $2, not $8.70. The VAT for the Dante Poet is 19% of $2, since the product cost is $0, so you are paying for shipping plus VAT, which totals $2.38.
The extra $6.32 is likely due to the 19% VAT applied to other items in your order, and unfortunately, there's nothing we can do about that.
To clarify, we promised the gift, but the shipping cost is the backer's responsibility. We're trying to absorb as many costs as possible, but some things are beyond our control. Also, keep in mind that we offer special pricing for bundles, and some add-ons have separate shipping costs due to their weight and dimensions.
With that said, we can remove the Dante Poet from your pledge, and you'll only have the VAT cost added to your order. Would you like us to do that?

Greetings Josh!
Thank you for reaching out and for the kind words about Chronicles of Drunagor. We're thrilled you're excited to dive into the world of Drunagor! It's awesome that you're already organizing your components – that's dedication!
Regarding your question about card organization, especially for Awakening and Apocalypse, you're right, it can be a bit tricky to determine the best way to arrange those campaign-specific cards. While the base box is more straightforward, the expansions introduce various card types with unique functions.
Here's the thing: those cards are designed to be used in a specific order within each campaign, and keeping them as close as possible to how they were originally packaged is actually a good approach. It might seem a bit chaotic at first glance, but there's a method to the madness.
The challenge lies in the fact that some cards, like Adventure Item cards and Special Event cards, might be mixed within the same adventure. This makes it difficult to separate them neatly.
So, here's the best way to organize your campaign cards:
Identify and Remove:
Take out the following cards from each campaign's card pool:
Hero Skill cards
Class cards
Dungeon Role cards
Camp Item cards (the yellow ones with a star)
Chest Item cards
Rune cards
White, Grey, and Black Monster cards (only)
Adventure Cards:
The remaining cards are all Adventure cards, including the Blue, Purple, Red, or Gold Monster cards. Each adventure will call for these cards in a specific order, which will become clearer as you play through the campaigns.
Maintain Order:
Keep the Adventure cards organized as closely as possible to the order they came in the packaging. This will help streamline gameplay and reduce time spent searching for specific cards during your adventures.
I understand you're aiming for a custom 3D-printed storage solution, which is a fantastic idea! This approach will definitely help you save space and optimize your gameplay.
If you have any more questions or need further clarification, feel free to ask! We're always happy to help you make the most of your Drunagor experience.
Happy gaming, and may your adventures in Drunagor be filled with epic battles and glorious victories!
​Best regards,
Maju Ronzani
Project Manager

Hi Maju,
Thank you for your email.
Before proceeding with the URL change, I want to inform you about the
impacts of the URL change listed below.
The "Forwarded to" Address under Admin > Email will automatically be updated once the URL is changed.This has to be manually copied and configured in the Support Mailbox for Email-Ticket Conversion.
If you are making use of a custom mailbox, after the URL change is done, the Admin has to manually reauthorise the mailboxes from within Freshdesk to avoid disconnection.
The old ticket URL to check the status of the ticket in your replies and in the email notifications etc will not work moving forward. An error message saying "we couldn’t find that helpdesk" will be prompted upon accessing the link.
The links to Solution Articles/Forums sent before the change to the customers will not work anymore.The updated link for the same has to be provided to the customers post the URL change.
If you had configured Webhooks using the Automation, you must update the callback URL in the respective automation rule, for it to work.
If there is any 3rd Party App integration that requires Freshdesk URL/domain to be specified at the time of integration, do update this as well. (For Eg; Freshdesk - SugarCRM Integration).
If you have set up a CNAME record, the CNAME pointed to Freshdesk URL will be automatically updated once the URL is changed. Hence the new Freshdesk URL need not be updated in the DNS records once again.
The Feedback widget code placed on any website or business applications should be modified with the new code once the URL is updated.
If you have integrated Freshdesk Messaging and Freshdesk Contact Center, they have to be updated with the New Freshdesk URL as well.
As soon as the URL is changed, the agents who have logged in will automatically be prompted with an error message saying "
We couldn’t find the URL
". To login again, they can use the new URL.
After considering the implications, if you still wish to change the URL, please follow the steps outlined below.
Go to
Admin Settings > Account > Helpdesk Settings
.
Click
Edit
next to the
Helpdesk URL
field. A warning banner will display the message "Helpdesk URL can only be changed once." and click on "Save"
Looking forward to hearing back from you!
Check your ticket status -
https://support.freshdesk.com/support/tickets/17420033
Best Regards,
Aishwarya Alex,
Product Specialist,
Freshdesk Support, Freshworks

Aloha!
  My name is Van Fujishige and I'm the Tabletop Gaming Director for Tabletop Oahu: Spring 2025, a new 2-day convention in Honolulu, Hawai'i that will run from May 31st to June 1st. Our convention strives to create a safe space in Hawai’i to celebrate all facets and uses of Tabletop Gaming to grow the community, embrace neurodiversity and mental health uses of gaming, and create opportunities and connections to the global tabletop gaming industry! Our first event was held in the Fall of last year and we hit our cap of 300 attendees; this year we anticipate numbers closer to 500.
  At the event, we'll have spaces for vendors, a gaming library with over 2000 games (https://tabletop.events/libraries/tabletop-oahu), a Play-and-Win section, demos, RPGs, Paint-and-Take, panels, a puzzle / quiet room, and more! We also have a dedicated volunteer staff of gamers that are knowledgeable about teaching games and running events. 
  Our gaming community is rapidly growing, and we'd love to have you be a part of it! We'd love to collaborate with you to run a demo or two, a tournament, or have your games as part of our Play-and-Win area. We also have booth space available if you'd like to be here in-person and enjoy a tropical semi-vacation! Sponsorship options can be seen here: https://tabletopoahu.com/sponsorships/
  Thank you for your consideration, and thanks for making great games!
  Van H. Fujishige

Hi Michael Fresner,
Could you provide me with your pledge number please? That way I can see exactly your case better.
But nonetheless, the Eternal Pledge shipping is always more costly than the Crusader Pledge shipping. What happens in our packaging is that, due to a deal we were able to make to reduce our shipping costs, those boxes specific boxes, or pledges, being that, explorer, crusader or eternal, have it's contents prepacked, what makes the full pledge shipping cost less than individual items.
​When you add an add-on to your pledge, it is being packed separately from the pledge itself, so each add-on require an unique handling until packed together, what makes this option more expensive, shipping-wise.
If you want to upgrade your pledge to include more add-ons, or have any other questions, feel free to message me!
Kind regards,

texto_original: I work with for Christian T.  Petersen, founder of Fantasy Flight Games and designer of games such as Twilight Imperium.  After stepping back from Asmodee in 2019, Christian launched a few new companies, as well as a software company aimed at creating tools to assist tabletop games publishers.     Specifically, I wanted to introduce you to our new software Forgefire, which we've been working on for the last three years and which we just recently announced. Forgefire is a complete development environment for tabletop games, especially card games, TCG's, or board games that use a lot of cards. You can read more about Forgefire here: www.forgefire.games.      We already have several publishers using the software. The KeyForge card game (which is procedurally generated using the Forgefire logic module) is made 100% inside Forgefire. I'd love for your company to see the tool.     An important service in Forgefire is Forgefire Connect, a complete end-to-end solution for high-quality print-on-demand products (serviced 100% factory-to-door to consumers by Forgefire Connect). This service enables publishers to monetize older products, custom "special items", reference cards, mini-expansions, etc.     I'd love to connect to schedule a demo of Forgefire, and to discuss whether Forgefire Connect print-on-demand would make sense for you.     Please let me know if you are open to a demo or just have questions you would like to have answered first. I would be happy to assist in any way I can.     Thank You for your time,  Alex

Sorry to hear that the problem persists.

In this particular case due to changing how the VAT (and shipping) is calculated by the creators it's impossible for us to easily fix the payment. It's highly unusual to change tax rates and shipping costs after they were collected, and so it's not something we can fix right away.
In this case you can either add something to the cart that exceeds 5$ value, or ask creators to cancel the order and re-instate it correctly configured. There's also a possibility of adding a 5$ fee to the order and then reimbursing you after it's paid. My name is Maju, and I'm the project manager at CGS. Our communication team has forwarded your case to me.
Regarding your question about the Eternal Box, yes, the neoprene mat is included inside the Eternal Box.
Regarding your VAT concerns, our team is currently in contact with GameFound to discuss this matter and find a resolution. You are correct that we do not use the VAT money for our financials, as it is a tax paid directly to the relevant government. However, our agreement with GameFound for this project is that they will handle the VAT payment this time. The funds will not be passed to us; we are simply handling the product entry declaration into Europe and covering that initial import tax, while GameFound will declare the individual VAT.

texto_original:
Hello,  Let me introduce myself. My username is Madjo, 36 years old. I opened my YouTube channel 5 years ago.  Followed by over 68,000 subscribers and over 15 million views during this period, I'm a big fan of video games, but also RPGs and other board games.  I recently realized (with the announcement of the board game Helldivers 2, where I was the reference in France for this video game upon its release) that my audience was completely unfamiliar with the world of board games, but they weren't indifferent.  "What is it? How do you play? Is it PvE? Where do you buy a box?" A lot of basic questions about the world of RPGs.  Since the release of Kingdom Come Deliverance 2, which I was lucky enough to have an exclusive preview from the publisher to work on. I noticed that my audience was rather receptive to this universe and I would have liked to present to my community a board game in a universe that they know particularly well, Chronique of Drunagor.
     My goal is to combine three things. My love for board games, my budding audience's curiosity for RPGs, and their interest in fantasy worlds like Drunagor, to launch a new video thread on my channel and demonstrate that miniatures are classy!  Following this overly long intro, I would have liked to have the French version of Chronique of Drunagor with the various main expansions to present not only the gameplay and the miniatures, but also explain how the rules work and what the expansions bring to the base box with new characters, weapons, etc.  My goal with this video is to remove the fear of starting a game of this style with many rules and components, while also introducing the board game, which offers an alternative to video game days/nights with friends, or even solo. For me, Drunagor fits perfectly with my project.     With Kingdom Come Deliverance 2, I know I have a niche to convert some members to board/figurine games, and I'd like your help with this project.  I'm not affiliated with any organization or partnership. Do you think you could grant my request or direct me to someone who might be able to answer it?  Thank you for reading and I look forward to your response. Here is my channel: https://www.youtube.com/@madjoYT  Sincerely, Madjo

texto_original:
Hi. I just recently acquired Age of Drunagor and a few of the expansions from one of my local brick and mortar stores. I was really excited for your products as they seemed to offer something unique and interesting to one of my favorite genres of board games.

Unfortunately when I received them I was rather disappointed in the quality of the models for the horsemen, especially for the size and the price. A lot of the details are blurry, some of the proportions are strange and there are some pieces that look somewhat cartoonish. As far as I can tell the models themselves aren't actually defective, but they certainly don't look anything like the only reference I could find for them online which was on your Kickstarter page.

If I had to guess it seems like there were a number of design decisions about the models that were made in consideration of the manufacturing process combined with concerns regarding structural integrity. Unfortunately it lead to a fairly significant decrease in quality. It's not as though I expect every game to have the same standard of models, but when I'm paying extra for an expansion solely for those models it seems fair to have a certain baseline.

This whole thing has taken a lot of the wind out of my sails regarding the game as a while, which is really unfortunate. Honestly I'm not sure which of the categories to submit this under as I've been considering whether I want to request a refund at this point. At the very least I'll probably at least keep the game itself and give it a try, but I really don't know what I'm going to do regarding the horsemen.

Hallo!
Danke für dein Interesse beim Korrektur- und Validierungsprozess für die deutsche Übersetzung von Dante: Inferno mitzuwirken. Mit dieser Herangehensweise möchten wir sicherstellen, dass die Übersetzung am Ende auch den Ansprüchen der deutschsprachigen Backer gerecht wird.
Die grundsätzliche Idee ist, dass ich der Gruppe mit den freiwilligen Helfern während des Übersetzungsprozesses immer mal wieder Ausschnitte bereits übersetzter Passagen zeige und dazu dann gerne Feedback hätte oder vielleicht auch konkrete Fragen dazu habe. Oder vielleicht auch sowas wie verschiedene Vorschläge zu bestimmten Schlüsselwörtern mit der Bitte den persönlichen Favoriten zu benennen.
Im späteren Verlauf kommt dann auch der Aspekt mit der Validierung/Konsistenzprüfung zum tragen. Denn wenn die deutschen Texte ins Spielmaterial eingearbeitet sind, dann gilt es natürlich auch noch zu überprüfen ob da alles stimmig ist. Läuft der Text irgendwo über den Rand hinaus? Sind die Abbildungen im Regelbuch alle korrekt ersetzt worden mit den deutschen Varianten des Spielmaterials? Stimmen die Seitenverweise im Regelbuch? Bei einem Spiel diesen Umfangs ist es natürlich gut wenn da bevor es in den Druck geht möglichst viele Augenpaare draufgeschaut haben.
Wann konkret es mit der ersten "Aufgabe" losgeht kann ich aktuell noch nicht benennen, das muss ich noch mit Marcel und dem Lektoren-Team absprechen. Aber ich würde mich dann zeitnah bei euch melden. - Name

- Discord Username

Hallo!
Danke für dein Interesse beim Korrektur- und Validierungsprozess für die deutsche Übersetzung von Dante: Inferno mitzuwirken. Mit dieser Herangehensweise möchten wir sicherstellen, dass die Übersetzung am Ende auch den Ansprüchen der deutschsprachigen Backer gerecht wird.
Die grundsätzliche Idee ist, dass ich der Gruppe mit den freiwilligen Helfern während des Übersetzungsprozesses immer mal wieder Ausschnitte bereits übersetzter Passagen zeige und dazu dann gerne Feedback hätte oder vielleicht auch konkrete Fragen dazu habe. Oder vielleicht auch sowas wie verschiedene Vorschläge zu bestimmten Schlüsselwörtern mit der Bitte den persönlichen Favoriten zu benennen.
Im späteren Verlauf kommt dann auch der Aspekt mit der Validierung/Konsistenzprüfung zum tragen. Denn wenn die deutschen Texte ins Spielmaterial eingearbeitet sind, dann gilt es natürlich auch noch zu überprüfen ob da alles stimmig ist. Läuft der Text irgendwo über den Rand hinaus? Sind die Abbildungen im Regelbuch alle korrekt ersetzt worden mit den deutschen Varianten des Spielmaterials? Stimmen die Seitenverweise im Regelbuch? Bei einem Spiel diesen Umfangs ist es natürlich gut wenn da bevor es in den Druck geht möglichst viele Augenpaare draufgeschaut haben.
Wann konkret es mit der ersten "Aufgabe" losgeht kann ich aktuell noch nicht benennen, das muss ich noch mit Marcel und dem Lektoren-Team absprechen. Aber ich würde mich dann zeitnah bei euch melden. Am einfachsten ist die Koordination für mich in absteigender Reihenfolge über folgende Kommunikationswege: Discord > WhatsApp/Signal > E-Mail.
Damit ich euch in die Helferliste aufnehmen kann würde ich euch bitten mir folgende Daten über euch mitzuteilen, damit ich direkt mit euch in Kontakt treten kann.
- Name
- E-Mail Adresse
- Mobilfunknummer
- Discord Username
Auf eine gute Zusammenarbeit!
Andreas
Community Manager

Danke für dein Interesse beim Korrektur- und Validierungsprozess für die deutsche Übersetzung von Dante: Inferno mitzuwirken. Mit dieser Herangehensweise möchten wir sicherstellen, dass die Übersetzung am Ende auch den Ansprüchen der deutschsprachigen Backer gerecht wird.
Die grundsätzliche Idee ist, dass ich der Gruppe mit den freiwilligen Helfern während des Übersetzungsprozesses immer mal wieder Ausschnitte bereits übersetzter Passagen zeige und dazu dann gerne Feedback hätte oder vielleicht auch konkrete Fragen dazu habe. texto_original: Dear Creative Games Studio Team,  I am Khor96, and I am reaching out to propose a potential collaboration. My YouTube channel is a reference point for Italian board game fans and currently counts well over 5,000 passionate subscribers, with steady growth.  My goal is to promote the tabletop hobby by scouting new releases in the industry. I focus on an Italian-speaking audience, producing in-depth content on board games, lore, painting, crafting, and unboxing, with strong attention to the narrative and visual presentation of each game.  I have followed with great enthusiasm the announcement of your Battleforge: Berserker. I am convinced that an Italian video dedicated to Battleforge could highlight not only its design, lore, and miniatures, but also its unique narrative elements. Therefore, I would like to propose a collaboration in exchange for a complimentary copy of your game, which I would use to create a video showcasing the box, its contents, the miniatures, and the lore.  I believe this collaboration would bring value to both parties: you would directly reach an enthusiastic Italian target audience, while I would provide original, high-quality content in Italian that excites the community.  Please let me know if this idea interests you (I’ve added my contact details below) and thank you for your attention. I would like to inform you that I will be available starting from September 8.   With passion and respect, Khor96     Mail: khor.beard@gmail.com  Youtube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@khor96

I have been waiting for this game for a long time and was very happy when I received your positive response. I hope you can help me resolve this issue! :-)     Wishing you a good and pleasant day!

texto_original: Hi Creative Games Studio Team,     we hope you’re doing great!     We wanted to reach out as huge fans of your work - especially Dante: Inferno and BattleForge: Berserker, both of which we personally supported with over €500 during crowdfunding. Your games consistently combine cooperative gameplay, strategic depth, and immersive thematic storytelling — elements that perfectly align with what we and our community love.     We recently came across Chronicles of Drunagor, and it immediately grabbed our attention. Its blend of tactical co-op, engaging narrative, and high-quality components seems like an ideal fit for a dedicated episode on our podcast. We believe we could help raise awareness and introduce this title to the German-speaking board game community.  We run Koop Kartell, the only German-language podcast fully dedicated to cooperative board games. Each episode (1.5–2 hours) dives into artwork, components, mechanics, difficulty, campaign structure, and teamwork dynamics. Chronicles of Drunagor is exactly the kind of game that our listeners love to explore in detail.     In the past months, we’ve had very successful collaborations with other publishers, such as:    One Hit Heroes (Frosted Games)    Uprising: Curse of the Last Emperor (Nemesis Games)    Under Our Sun (Tabletopper Games)    These collaborations generated strong listener engagement, direct feedback from players who backed or purchased the featured games, and increased visibility within the co-op community - exactly the kind of impact we’d love to create for Chronicles of Drunagor.  We’ve attached our latest podcast handout, which includes detailed information on our reach, growth, audience demographics, and examples of past collaborations.     If review or press copies of Chronicles of Drunagor (and potential upgrades/expansions) are available (as we typically prefer playing the games in English instead of German), we’d be thrilled. This would allow us to produce a full-length, in-depth episode after extensive playtime, and ideally start a long-term collaboration to help introduce your game to even more players in Germany. Hey Marcio,



You can export lots of things in “Orders” tab. Just filter people by “Order contains product”, click the checkbox next to “Order ID”, and then “export” button.

​
2 - Why am I seeing an extra amount being charged on my EZ Pay order?
A few of our EZ Pay backers have reached out to us claiming that an additional value is being charged after they completed their installments. When checking these pledges, what we saw is that other rewards were added while the EZ Pay down payment for their reward was removed.
If you are an EZ Pay backer, we ask you to please refrain from deleting two items from your order:
EZ PAY - *reward name* [$99.99 + *number and value of installments* = *total value]
and
EZ PAY - *reward name* - COMPLETED
. These two items are essential for the EZ Pay rewards to be counted as paid.

EZ PAY - *reward name* [$99.99 + *number and value of installments* = *total value]
sub-items.

EZ PAY - *reward name* - COMPLETED

Single Wave:
Single wave shipping will be, as expected, the only choice for backers that got only the Reprint or only the New Content. If you got only Reprint rewards, your pledge will go in the 1st wave; if you got only New Content rewards, your pledge will go in the 2nd wave.
Single Wave will be also available for those that pledged both Reprint and New Content, however, the only choice for Single Wave, in this case, is to have everything shipped together, at once, in the 2nd wave. That will happen in December after the production of Apocalypse ends.
Split Shipping:
Two waves shipping, or Split Shipping, will
only be available for backers that pledge both Reprint items and New Content
items. In this option, you will have your Reprint items shipped in the 1st wave, and your New Content items shipped in the 2nd. You cannot, however, choose which items are shipped and when. Reprint will go in the 1st wave, New Content in the 2nd.

Hi Sebastian,
​
Thank you for contacting us and for supporting Chronicles of Drunagor.
​
Regarding your inquiry, you will see a period of 3 months on your EZ Pay order, however, there will be only 2 installments.
The reason why you see "Processing" is that we are using a recurring billing system as a subscription and it works as in a prepaid system, where you pay at the beginning of a month and then you have the next 30 days to "use" it. Therefore, when you make your last installment, the second and last, it will appear that you have one month left to "use" your subscription, just as if it were a regular subscription service, but it will no longer generate any charges in this last period.
Additionally, we have identified that your card was being steadily declined since August 29th, when the first installment was to be charged, and only was accepted and the payment went through on October 4th. That only means that your second and last installment will be charged on November 4th. There should be no need for you to do anything from your side as the system should charge you automatically your second installment.
Regarding the EZ Pay Pledge Manager, there is nothing to be worried about. We have addressed this aspect of the EZ Pay pledges on our update #39 which you can check
here
.
​
We have also just checked your order and subscription and both seem to be OK.
If you have any further inquiries or anything else we can assist you with, please do not hesitate to contact us again.
Best regards,

Dear Dario Albanesi,
 

First, we would like to thank you for supporting Chronicles of Drunagor: Age of Darkness Apocalypse.
 

We are reaching out today regarding your EZ Pay registration. We know that some backers had issues with this new system, and despite our efforts, not all of these issues could be solved during the campaign.
 

However, now that the campaign is finished, we had time to look at the registrations and identify those that had some kind of issue while registering for EZ Pay and decided to assist those that want to complete their EZ Pay pledge.
 
We have already sent an email previously in the same regard, and although many backers could complete their subscription after that, there are still many that have not. Therefore we are re-sending this email in hopes it will help.


In your case, we identified that your EZ Pay registration was not finished successfully, and, therefore, if you still want to keep your pledge, we need you to finalize it. This is also a friendly reminder that if you do not complete your subscription at our website for the EZ Pay, your pledge will be lost.
 
To assist you, we will try to walk you through the process.
 
Please bear in mind that we are doing an exceptional extension on the EZ Pay registration period and we are not sure until when we are able to keep it open. So please, finalize your registration if you want to keep your pledge as soon as possible.
 
Since all is right with your account and order at Gamefound, we just need to set up the EZ Pay part. For that, please follow the steps below:
 
1- Click on this link to go to your pledge level page: https://store.wearecgs.com/product/ez-pay-gameplay-all-in/
 
2- Click on “PAY NOW”;
 
3- Click on “VIEW CART”;


 
4- Then on the new screen click on “PROCEED TO CHECKOUT”;


 
5- On the new screen, fill in your personal information. The email address must be the same as the one on your Gamefound pledge. The same goes for your PLEDGE ID NUMBER. If in doubt, just go to Gamefound and check the status of your pledge before filling out;


 
6- Check your pledge;

respostas:
Greetings hero,
Thank you for contacting us.
Regarding your inquiry, you will see a period of 6 months on your EZ Pay order, however, there will be only 5 installments.
The reason is that we are using a recurring billing system as a subscription and it works as in a prepaid system where you pay at the beginning of a month and then you have the next 30 days to "use" it. Therefore, when you make your last installment, the fifth and last, it will show that you have one month left of to "use" your subscription, just as if it were a regular subscription service, but it will no longer generate any charges in this last period.
If you have any further inquiries or anything else we can assist you with, please do not hesitate to contact us again.

respostas:
Hi Jesse,
Thank you for contacting us.
Regarding your inquiry, you will see the "Processing" status on your EZ Pay order installments, which means that they were successfully charged.
The reason for that is we are using a recurring billing system as in a subscription and it works as in a prepaid system, where you pay at the beginning of a month and then you have the next 30 days to "use" it. Therefore, when an installment status is changed to "Processing", it just means that installment was successfully charged. They will not change from "Processing" even after that 30 days period end. When the installment is not successfully charged, the status will change to "Failed".
We have also checked your Gamefound order and we noticed that there is no EZ Pay Master All-in downpayment in your order. Every EZ Pay reward is composed by a $99.99 downpayment "product" that is added and paid directly through Gamefound plus the installments. That being said, we can easily add the downpayment product to your order as soon as you finish paying all the installments and you will be able to pay it directly through Gamefound for your convenience.
If you have any further inquiries or anything else we can assist you with, please do not hesitate to contact us again.
Best regards,
Augusto
Customer Service

respostas:
Hi Josh,
​
Thank you for contacting us regarding this.
​
We have checked your EZ Pay subscription and identified the issue with your second and last installment. It was declined on October 23rd due to the "card number being incorrect".
​
Regarding your Gamefound order, all your items are still there. Nothing has been removed. The $170 EZ Pay Completed product is only there to inform the Gamefound system that your reward is complete. However, due to the last installment not being charged, you can now pay that last installment through Gamefound for your convenience, and, therefore, complete your order.
Now the reason why you have seen the $89.99 value is due to a difference in products. In your order there is a
NEW CONTENT: Apocalypse Adventures
($95) reward, which is different from the
EZ Pay New Content All in
($99,99) reward, which is the first downpayment of the EZ Pay rewards as showed on the reward info.
Since the Gamefound system needs both the downpayment ($99.99) and the complete product($170) to identify the reward as completely paid,
it is now charging, together with the last installment of $85, the difference of $4.99 between the
NEW CONTENT: Apocalypse Adventures
($95) reward and the
EZ Pay New Content All in
($99,99) reward.
We hope to have been able to clarify the situation.

Regarding your inquiry, you will see a period of 6 months on your EZ Pay order, however, there will be only 5 installments.

The reason for that is we are using a recurring billing system as a subscription and it works just as in a prepaid system, where you pay at the beginning of a month and then you have the next 30 days to "use" it. Therefore, when you make your last installment, the fifth and last, it will appear that you have one month left to "use" your subscription, just as if it were a regular subscription service, but it will no longer generate any charges in this last period.

Hi Oliver,
Thank you for contacting us.
Regarding your inquiry, you will see a period of 6 months on your EZ Pay order, however, there will be only 5 installments.
​
The reason for that is we are using a recurring billing system as a subscription and it works just as in a prepaid system, where you pay at the beginning of a month and then you have the next 30 days to "use" it. Therefore, when you make your last installment, the fifth and last, it will appear that you have one month left to "use" your subscription, just as if it were a regular subscription service, but it will no longer generate any charges in this last period.
